jobs.title: Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Dasher Financial Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: Austin, TX; Washington, D.C; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Chicago, IL; Tempe, AZ
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Dasher & Logistics team supports the millions of Dashers who power DoorDash’s marketplace. We’re building the world’s leading last-mile logistics platform — and to succeed, we’ll need to disrupt ourselves along the way. The Dasher Financial team is one such disruption: we are building fintech products that best serve the needs of Dashers and gig workers like them.

From instant access to earnings, to innovative bill pay and savings products, to credit-building tools, our goal is to create the financial system of record for Dashers. We are early in this journey — launching and scaling zero-to-one products that redefine how Dashers interact with their money.

About the Role

We are looking for an Associate, Strategy & Operations to join our Dasher Financial team. This role is about building the operations of a bank program at scale — a bank product that is already used by millions of Dashers each month.

Unlike traditional banks that feel slow and impersonal, our ambition is to build a financial product that is fast, intuitive, and genuinely supportive — one that helps Dashers not just hold money, but actively improve their financial health. To deliver on that promise, we need exceptional operators who can take tough operational problems, turn them into clear plans, and drive them to completion.

As an Associate, you will:

- Own a core area of the Crimson banking program end to end — the metrics, the operating model, and the cross-functional partners who make it work

- Turn ambiguous operational problems into structured plans, and drive them through Product, Engineering, Legal, and external partners

- Build the monitoring and mechanisms that catch problems before users report them, rather than after

- Manage external vendors and partners: hold them to their SLAs, escalate when they miss, and negotiate what we need

Disputes & Support

This role owns the Crimson support and disputes experience — the systems, partners, and processes that determine whether a Dasher who has a problem gets it solved. You'll own dispute operations as we bring them in-house, Crimson support performance and tooling, and the complaint monitoring that tells us what's actually broken in the product.

Growth Ops

This role owns the top of the Crimson funnel: identity verification and onboarding, and the campaigns that bring non-Crimson Dashers and DoorDash consumers into the product. You'll own KYC health and vendor performance, reduce friction from application through first use, and drive acquisition.

Dasher Financial is an ambitious bet - building fintech products for the future of work. For someone with a strong foundation in problem solving who wants to grow into a future operator or general manager, this is a rare opportunity to learn by doing in a zero-to-one environment.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Analyze & problem-solve : Break down ambiguous problems, run analyses, and recommend solutions that improve adoption, retention, and trust.

- Drive execution : Own and deliver discrete projects that move our key metrics (e.g., deposits, bill pay adoption, dispute resolution SLA).

- Experiment & learn : Design and test hypotheses, measure impact, and help scale what works.

- Collaborate : Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, and Legal to launch and improve initiatives.

- Grow fast : Build the toolkit of a future operator/GM by working on zero-to-one fintech problems in a high-growth environment.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 2-3 years of experience and have succeeded in high-growth teams (whether in tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience)

- You have exceptional problem-solving skills and back your decisions with data (comfortable pulling SQL or modeling in Excel)

- You’re curious, driven, and comfortable with ambiguity

- You want to learn fast and take ownership

- You have a Bachelor’s Degree in a related field

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here .

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA ; New York City, NY; Chicago, IL; Seattle, WA; Denver, CO
jobs.description:
About the Team

- The Dasher Tasks team is expanding what it means to earn on DoorDash. We let Dashers do work far beyond delivery, from photographing a merchant's menu to assisting autonomous vehicles, to collecting data. Adding these Tasks gives dashers greater opportunities to earn and smoothes a Dashers earnings throughout the day.

- The work compounds across all three sides of our marketplace: new off-peak earning for millions of Dashers, real-world capacity and insight for businesses, and everyday convenience for customers.

- We are on our way to building the next billion dollar business at DD, with more than 2 million tasks completed since 2025 and partners across retail, insurance, hospitality, and technology.

About the Role

- As an Associate you'll own a slice of Dasher Tasks end to end; sizing the opportunity, designing the operation, launching pilots, and scaling what works. Your focus will flex to wherever the business needs it most: new task types, commercial pilots or international market expansion opportunities,

- First 30 days: learn the business, our metrics, and tooling, and shadow live operations. By 60 days: own a workstream or pilot and ship your first improvements. By 90 days: independently run a pilot or market and move a core metric.

- Expect ambiguity, shifting priorities, and few established playbooks. With these complications come outsized ownership, direct exposure to senior leaders, and the chance to shape a multi-billion-dollar new business from the ground up. It's a rare moment to get in early.

- You’ll report direction to the Manager on the Dasher Tasks with the Dasher and Logistics Organization

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own end-to-end workstreams across Dasher Tasks, from the first hypothesis and analysis all the way through launching and scaling the operation.

- Turn messy, real-world data into decisions: pull your own data in SQL, model in Excel/Sheets, define the KPIs that matter, and lean on AI tools to move faster.

- Partner broadly with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and S&O leadership.

- Build the playbooks, SOPs, and processes that turn a scrappy pilot into a durable business, and see your work in Dashers' and customers' hands within weeks, not quarters.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 1-3 years of experience in strategy & operations, consulting, investment banking, analytics, program management, or a high-growth startup/ops environment, and you've owned projects end to end.

- You're data-fluent and analytical: comfortable pulling data in SQL and modeling in Excel/Sheets to drive decisions, or able to ramp there quickly.

- You operate with an ownership mentality in ambiguity: structured, resourceful, biased to action, and willing to get into the weeds with a high bar for operational quality.

- You put AI to work to accelerate your analysis and execution.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

jobs.description:
About the Team

AI Research Lab is one of DoorDash’s frontier innovation hubs, focused on building the foundation for an AI-native future across our three core audiences: consumers, merchants, and dashers. As AI capabilities accelerate, the AI Research Lab operates at the center of technical exploration and real-world execution — connecting frontier model research, internal platform investments, operator teams, and strategic external partners.

Our mission is to translate cutting-edge AI research into scalable, production-ready systems that drive measurable business impact. We combine deep technical rigor with strong operational execution to ensure that breakthrough capabilities become durable competitive advantages for DoorDash.

About the Role

As an Associate Manager, Strategy & Operations on our AI Research Lab, you will play a central role in converting frontier AI advancements into shipped products and scalable infrastructure. You will operate across research, product, and operations to move from early discovery and experimentation to deployment and impact.

This role sits at the intersection of customer insight, technical innovation, and business execution. You will help define and scale the Lab’s most important bets while building the foundations that enable AI applications to compound over time.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will …

- Reimagining core experiences through AI, such as the merchant journey, by partnering directly with in-field merchants, sales, support, product, and engineering teams. You will help unify major initiatives into a coherent, AI-native interaction model.

- Own revenue-driving AI initiatives, operating as the accountable business owner for high-priority AI bets and ensuring clear linkage between technical progress and financial outcomes.

- Lead business planning cycles, developing go-to-market strategies for AI-powered products and capabilities, overseeing execution through structured project plans, resource allocation, and KPI tracking.

- Develop new business metrics and measurement frameworks, including:

- Defining what should be measured and why

- Establishing performance thresholds using data-driven benchmarking

- Localizing metrics across geographies and market types

- Driving AI adoption across DoorDash by enabling non-technical teams with enterprise tools, workflows, and experimentation sandboxes that integrate AI into daily operations.

- Building scalable AI foundations, including evaluation datasets, guardrails, monitoring systems, and strategies for custom foundation models that ensure safety, reliability, and long-term leverage.

- Operationalizing frontier technologies from external partners, translating research breakthroughs into revenue-generating product capabilities and production systems.

- Leading rapid experimentation cycles, validating product-market fit, measuring business impact, and ensuring AI initiatives translate into tangible outcomes.

This role requires an entrepreneurial leader who thrives in ambiguity and can bridge technical depth with structured execution. You should be comfortable engaging directly with merchants, collaborating with engineers on model evaluation strategies, structuring strategic AI partnerships, and diving into metrics to diagnose performance.

We’re excited about you because…

- Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience in finance, management consulting, business operations, business analytics, or high-growth/early-stage startup environments

- Exceptional communicator and operator who can partner directly with in-field merchants, sales, and support teams to uncover workflow pain points, translate them into AI-native product opportunities, and drive adoption across internal stakeholders

- Strong analytical thinker who thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments — able to extract clear, actionable recommendations and measurement frameworks out of fast-moving, frontier-AI research and bring structure to unstructured problems

- Hands-on experience leveraging AI tooling (Claude Codex, Codex, Cursor etc) in day-to-day work to accelerate discovery, prototype workflows, build eval datasets, and test hypotheses faster than traditional product cycles allow

- Direct experience productizing LLM/ML systems (shipping features, building eval datasets, or running model-performance feedback loops) is a strong plus

jobs.title: Associate Manager,  DashMart - Supply Chain Profitability Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Washington D.C; Chicago, IL; Tempe, AZ
jobs.description:
About the Team

Our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team is re-inventing the way consumers think about grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail delivery through both our first-party and third-party operations businesses. DashMarts are our first-party offering designed to provide on-demand deliveries by selling household essentials, groceries, brand-name favorites, local favorites and so much more. The end to end DashMart experience is powered through DoorDash. Third-party partnerships enable us to offer on-demand deliveries from both SMB and enterprise merchants across grocery, convenience alcohol and retail storefronts. The merchants own the inventory, we fulfill and deliver them!

About the Role

We are hiring an Associate Manager to join the DashMart Strategy & Operations organization, focused on reducing supply chain costs to fuel profitability. In this role, you will own the end-to-end effort to reduce shrink, using SQL and AI to analyze data and identify opportunities, then designing and implementing solutions from the ground up. Solutions may be process-driven, working closely with Ops, Supply Chain, Vendor Management, and Category, or product-driven, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable fixes. You will be goaled directly against a key profitability metric, making this a highly visible role with outsized impact on the bottom line.

We're looking for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who can think outside the box to uncover non-obvious opportunities and creative solutions. You should bring a high degree of ownership and be comfortable independently driving a project from data analysis through cross-functional execution. This role sits at the intersection of operations, product, and finance, and is critical to DashMart's profitability goals.

You will report into a Manager within the DashMart team. We operate in a hybrid work model with opportunities for in-person collaboration a few times a year, and all our offices are open should you choose to go in on a more regular basis! All employees that work on DashMart are also expected to spend time understanding the operation on site.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Strategize . You’ll set financial goals for Shrink in both the short and long term, and create the playbook to achieve those goals.

- Analyze . You'll assess financial opportunity and operational impacts of your decisions across the entire business, and iterate based on data.

- Build . You’ll own the implementation of your strategies end to end, from documenting processes and requirements to measuring the success of the results.

- Scale . You’ll transform analytical insights into operational experiments that create measurable and scalable improvements to profitability.

- Lead and collaborate . You’ll influence a cross-functional team including category management, vendor management, central operations, product, engineering, and finance to solve problems and scale solutions.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have subject matter expertise in process improvement, data modeling, supply chain, and strong financial and business acumen.

- You’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds with SQL and data analysis, but you’re just as comfortable influencing roadmap discussions and strategic priorities.

- You're unafraid of undefined processes. You are a creative problem solver who’s proficient at defining net new processes. You excel at working with a diverse group of people.

- You’re analytical. You have a strong analytical background, advanced SQL proficiency, and experience with analytical visualization tooling (Sigma, Mode, Tableau, etc.). You have past experience building SQL queries from scratch and leveraging insights to drive business decisions.

- You are AI native. You think systematically about where AI can make your work better and have used AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini, etc. to enhance, refine and deepen your workflows.

- You have 4-6+ years of experience. You've succeeded at expanding businesses (whether in tech, retail, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience).

- You have completed your BS/BA Degree ideally in supply chain, business, economics, engineering or a related field.

DoorDash Digital Ordering is DoorDash’s first software-as-a-service business unit – offering a suite of services across online ordering, branded mobile apps, loyalty solutions, and more that enable merchants (restaurants, grocers, retailers, etc.) to reach customers through their own first-party channels.

The business is one of the fastest-growing segments within DoorDash, and yet is only scratching the surface of a generational opportunity to better serve hundreds of thousands of merchants to help them grow their business and improve working lives in one of the country’s biggest industry sectors.

As an Associate Manager on the Digital Ordering Strategy & Operations team, you will play a critical role in building a world-class SaaS business. You will be responsible for defining and leading key go-to-market bets and initiatives to scale our business nationwide. About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores and has made DoorDash the #1 third-party marketplace for grocery and retail in the US.

Within New Verticals, the Consumer Strategy & Operations team focuses on building consumer growth levers through many different outlets. The Pricing & Affordability team is redefining what value means in delivery. Our mission is to make DoorDash the smartest, most affordable place to shop. The pricing, fee, and savings systems we build are a big part of why customers choose DoorDash and stay. We're building toward a future where every customer feels DoorDash is worth it on every order. Getting there takes sharp, quantitative thinking about how we price and where we invest.

About the Role

As an Associate Manager, you'll be the core owner behind how we approach consumer strategy using pricing as a growth lever, with a deep focus on fee structure and affordability. You will spend your days understanding our end to end financials by looking at the ins and outs of our P&L, order data and pricing data to drive changes to how we make DoorDash more affordable for our consumers. You’ll work closely with Finance, Analytics, and Product in forecasting consumer and financial impacts, building pricing models, design A/B tests, and launching new fee structures. It's a high-visibility seat at the intersection of strategy, operations, and finance - your analyses will inform decisions that reach millions of customers.

The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks. This is an individual contributor role reporting into a Senior Manager on the New Verticals Affordability team within the broader New Verticals Consumer organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Analyze. Run SQL queries and build Excel models to quantify the consumer, operational, and financial tradeoffs of fee changes, leveraging AI tools like Claude & Cursor to automate and move faster.

- Build with AI . You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.

- Forecast. Partner with Finance to project how pricing decisions will play out, and track actuals against those projections once programs are live.

- Experiment. Work with Analytics to design A/B tests across markets and verticals, and translate the results into crisp read-outs and recommendations for senior leadership.

- Operate and Collaborate. Own the metrics and dashboards for your programs, sharing with partners across the New Verticals organization.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 4-6+ years of success in highly analytical roles : investment banking, corporate FP&A, management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations is required.

You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.

- You enjoy ambiguity. You break messy, open-ended problems down from first principles and turn them into clear plans, taking responsibility for moving things forward.

- You are analytical. You thrive on analytical tasks, building models and forecasts from scratch.

- You have a completed Bachelor's Degree, MBA a plus.

Our sales and partner management teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, enabling us to sign and partner with top restaurants across the country to drive revenue and help our partners operate and grow their businesses. As DoorDash grows both in scale and breadth of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it.

About the Role

As Associate Manager, Sales Strategy and Planning at DoorDash, you will play a pivotal role in executing against top company business objectives and help define our sales strategy and planning roadmap. Your responsibilities will range from strategic (designing quotas and incentives aligned to the company's goals and strategy, integrating new products into sales GTM strategy and building consensus among sales leadership) to operational (forecasting, designing compensation plans, driving plan implementation and ensuring key metrics can be communicated, tracked and commissions calculated). You will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales leadership while driving operational discipline across the organization. You will own cross-functional programs end-to-end, ensuring alignment across Sales, Product, Finance, Analytics, and Sales Operations to achieve business goals while proactively building partnerships, promoting open dialogue and creative insights expertise to issues in real time. This role specifically supports our US and CAN Ads and Promos Post-Sales organization spanning multiple sales motions and role types. You'll be the primary planning and strategy partner for a high-velocity, high-volume sales motion where quota attainment, goaling accuracy / consistency, and rep productivity are the north stars. This role will report into a Senior Manager, Sales Strategy and Planning.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will be driving…

- Strategic Leadership : Become the subject matter expert on sales data, sales incentives, while also gaining a comprehensive understanding of the sales process and drivers for each business unit we support.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, HR and Product to drive alignment and support decision-making.

- Data Analysis and Insights : Analyze large datasets to derive actionable insights, identify trends, and provide recommendations to improve sales performance and efficiency.

- Sales Performance Optimization : Collaborate with Sales leadership to develop and implement strategies to optimize sales performance including incentive redesigns and pilot testing.

- Forecasting and Reporting : Develop and maintain sales forecasting models, track key performance metrics, and prepare regular reports for executive leadership and Sales teams.

- Strategic growth and Org Design : Translate complex analyses into executive-ready insights and strategic recommendations. Anticipate future organizational needs, planning for headcount allocation, territory design, and structural evolution to support long-term growth

We’re excited about you because you have…

- 4+ years of experience and a bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. An advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS) is a plus.

- Proven experience within Sales Planning, Sales Operations, Sales Analytics or related field, preferably in the tech marketplace, logistics, or e-commerce industry.

- Hands-on experience with quota setting, incentive design, compensation modeling, and forecasting

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights.

- Demonstrated strong ownership, prioritization, and decision-making skills in fast-paced environments.

- Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact.Strong problem-solving skills and a strategic mindset.

- An ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

We’re excited about you because you are…

- Entrepreneurial – You have a bias towards action, an ownership mentality and are able to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly changing work environment

- Naturally curious – You always look for ways to innovate and improve and want to share the vision and direction of the company

- Gritty – You roll up your sleeves and do whatever it takes to make things successful

- Relationship-builder  – You can influence and motivate people at all levels across a variety of job functions

- Problem solver – You can independently translate high-level goals into actionable plans

Qualifications

- Proven experience within Sales Operations, Sales Planning, Sales Analytics or related field, preferably in the tech marketplace, logistics, or e-commerce industry.

- A bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. An advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS) is a plus.

- Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, hitting goals, and succeeding in a complex and fast moving environment

- You have experience working with sales organizations

- You have experience with sales incentive design

- Excellent analytical thinker who can deliver actionable recommendations out of complex datasets. Proven user and explorer of AI tooling to drive efficiency and improved processes; SQL experience required, along with Salesforce and Excel

- Expert communication and interpersonal skills

- Experience mapping complex operational workflows, diagnosing data gaps, and architecting AI-driven solutions end-to-end—from process discovery through prototype to production deployment. Experience building in AI tooling (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) and ship real automation that eliminates manual work, closes visibility gaps, and accelerates decision-making across the business. You think in systems, not features. You treat every broken process as a build opportunity and every data gap as a use case waiting to be deployed. This is not an AI-curious role; this is an AI-native operating environment where you are expected to build, test, and iterate continuously.

- You have experience with Incentive Management tools (e.g., Anaplan, Xactly)

About the Team

DoorDash Digital Ordering is DoorDash’s leading SaaS business unit, offering a suite of products across online ordering, branded websites and mobile apps, loyalty solutions, and more that enable restaurants to reach customers and grow their revenue through their own first-party channels.

The business is one of the fastest-growing segments within DoorDash, and yet is only scratching the surface of a generational opportunity to better serve hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas to help them grow their business and improve working lives in one of the country’s biggest industry sectors.

Strategy & Operations sits at the center of that opportunity. The team partners with Product to set the strategy and vision for every offering in the suite, across our SMB and enterprise merchants. We decide what to build, where to invest, and how to bring it to market, and we learn by putting products in front of merchants and running the experiments that show us what moves their business.

As part of this team, the Associate Manager will take end-to-end ownership of a set of products and lead the cross-functional effort to grow them. Your work will be instrumental to helping transition DoorDash from a consumer marketplace to an industry-leading B2B SaaS company.

About the Role

As an Associate Manager on the Digital Ordering Strategy & Operations team, you will own a set of products within our first-party suite from end to end. You will set the strategy and priorities for those products in partnership with Product, be accountable for their growth, and lead the Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, and Marketing partners who bring them to market. This role is ideal for a strategic operator who can move fast and wear many hats, equal parts analyst, builder, operator, and cross-functional leader.

You will own zero-to-one experiments alongside products already operating at scale, help shape the roadmap with Product, and work directly with merchants and frontline teams to identify the gaps worth solving. Scope on this team grows with demonstrated ownership, and the people who do well here identify problems independently and come back with a plan to solve them.

Scope for this role can vary between Foundation Products: the products that are table stakes for every restaurant we serve and that drive the core of our revenue today, and Growth & Insights:  the next generation of products and the experimentation engine behind them.

We’re especially excited about candidates who’ve worked in fast-moving, founder-led, or resource-constrained environments, those who see lack of structure as an opportunity to build.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

- Own the product line: Take end-to-end ownership of your products. Set the strategy, define the goals and KPIs that measure success, and prioritize where to invest. You will build the business case, the financial model, and the operating plan, then carry them through launch and into growth.

- Lead cross-functionally: Bring Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, Marketing, and Support behind a plan and hold partners accountable to it without formal authority. You will be the connective tissue that keeps a launch on schedule and the feedback loop that informs what gets built next.

- Analyze: Pair complex data analysis with qualitative insight from merchants and frontline teams to guide strategic decisions. You will build your own models and translate what you find into action that improves both the merchant experience and internal execution.

- Experiment: Design and launch zero-to-one tests, pilot AI-powered tools, build demos or prototype agents, and configure internal tooling that improves speed, accuracy, or effectiveness. You will move quickly to retire what does not work and scale what does.

- Represent the merchant: Act as the voice of the merchant and the field, leading discovery interviews and synthesizing feedback from Sales, Implementation, Support, and merchants themselves to help influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities. You will ensure our products resonate with restaurants and scale with repeatable excellence.

- Scale learnings: Codify what works. Build the repeatable frameworks, processes, and enablement that raise the bar across the org, and define best practices for launching new products in a way that’s scalable and measurable.

The best candidates will:

- Think like a founder, identifying the problems nobody flagged, building the case for solving them, and driving them to resolution with limited structure or direction

- Bring strong analytical horsepower and intellectual curiosity, comfortable diving into complex data and extracting insights that drive real-world decisions

- Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments, moving with urgency, defaulting to action, taking ownership end to end, and knowing when to bend process to get things done

- Lead cross-functional teams through influence, building trust with Product, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing partners and holding them to their commitments

- Carry executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leaders, defending a recommendation with data, and adapting the message to the audience

- Have experience working closely with Sales or frontline teams, and know how to turn insights from those teams into action

- Demonstrate comfort with AI, automation, or internal tooling to drive process efficiency, enable scale, or prototype solutions

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own products from end to end and be accountable for their growth

- Imagine, develop, and execute on workstreams from start to completion with little oversight

- Oscillate easily from strategic considerations to tactical execution

- Build deep and meaningful relationships with merchants, laser focused on helping them thrive

- Have the opportunity to truly make a scalable, measurable impact on the restaurant industry in the US and abroad

- Operate comfortably in ambiguous environments while maintaining a strong bias for action

- Grow your scope as you demonstrate ownership and impact

- Communicate precisely dependent on audience and level of detail necessary to share

- Represent the DoorDash brand with humility and a customer-first mindset

We’re excited about you because you…

- 4-7 years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, product, or founder-type roles

- Have taken a product or concept from inception through launch and into growth, leading cross-functional partners without a fully defined brief

- Demonstrate the judgment to set a product’s direction and prioritize the gaps that matter most to the business

- Can devise and execute a strategy to achieve business outcomes

- Bring a strong analytical background, with the ability to synthesize large data sets into meaningful insights (proficiency in SQL preferred)

- Lead cross-functionally and influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Marketing

- Develop goals and OKRs to measure success, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome

- Carry executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging across audiences (e.g., sales reps, execs, and merchants)

- Pilot or build with AI tools in real-world workflows

- Bring a founder mindset, identifying problems independently and driving them to resolution

- Bachelor's degree required

Bonus if you have experience with:

- Founding or operating your own company or product, or an early employee role at a startup

- Building and executing go-to-market motions

- Working in a high-growth environment

- Client or account management

- Building financial or sales forecasting models

- Restaurant, SaaS, or marketplace businesses

- Both zero-to-one work in a lean environment and scaling products at a larger organization

- Are the first in your family to attend college

jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Strategy & Operations team at DoorDash is the driving force behind the In-Store business line’s long-term growth and operational excellence. We work cross-functionally to develop and execute key initiatives that align with In-Store's strategic goals, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and optimal performance across the organization. Our team is focused on leveraging data-driven insights, improving processes, and guiding business decisions that enhance customer experience and foster company-wide innovation.

About the Role

DoorDash is looking for a senior Associate Manager, Strategy & Operations to own and accelerate our global payments growth strategy. In this highly visible role, you will act as the strategic "train conductor" for our payments business, working to hit ambitious annual revenue targets by driving the adoption of transactional features across our merchant base.

To be successful, you must possess a deep understanding of the payments industry—specifically how payment gateways, Merchant of Record (MoR) models, and transaction fees operate within B2B SaaS ecosystems. You will be directly goaled on moving the needle on critical metrics: increasing payments attach rates, boosting online GMV per venue, and optimizing our take rates. You will partner closely with Product to build new payment-driving features from scratch, shape our global Pricing & Packaging strategy, and rally Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to execute holistic Go-To-Market launches. This role requires a highly autonomous, confident leader who thrives in ambiguity, can synthesize complex data into actionable insights, and can influence executive stakeholders without direct authority.

The ideal candidate is an autonomous owner who can build consensus, synthesize complex data, and navigate 0-to-1 product launches in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Drive Payments Growth: Own the strategy to increase the adoption of existing payment-driving features (e.g., deposits, cancellation fees, pre-paid experiences) and partner with Product to identify, test, and launch new transactional capabilities.

- Pricing & Packaging: Actively manage and optimize our transactional economic model. You will strategize around take rates, processing fees, and consumer pass-through options to ensure we are maximizing payment revenue while incentivizing merchant GMV growth.

- Cross-Functional Project Management: Act as the strategic "train conductor" across Product, Sales, Marketing, Product, Sales, and Legal. Bring people together, gather requirements, manage strict timelines, and drive complex initiatives forward without direct authority. You will work closely with leadership, leveraging your analytical skills to identify challenges, develop solutions, and ensure successful project execution in line with our growth objectives. You will establish clear metrics for success and designate project components to the appropriate cross-functional DRIs (Directly Responsible Individuals). You will be responsible for removing or escalating roadblocks to ensure project timelines are achieved.

- Market & Competitive Strategy: Size market opportunities and conduct deep competitive research for the region, diving into specific customer segments to understand what is working and analyzing closed-lost deals to understand what isn't. Ensure global product strategies account for local nuances.

- Data-Driven Insights: Dive deep into our data to uncover hidden trends, analyze product adoption, and monitor competitive dynamics. You will be responsible for developing dashboards, KPIs, and reports that translate complex data into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations.

- Executive Visibility & Alignment: Translate highly ambiguous project scopes into structured, actionable plans. Communicate updates, roadblocks, and strategic recommendations clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.

- Risk Management: Anticipate and proactively manage obstacles and risks to strategic projects, developing mitigation strategies to keep initiatives on track.

We’re excited about you because…

- Experienced Operator: You have 5-7 years of experience in management consulting, finance, or Strategy & Operations, ideally within a high-growth Big Tech or B2B SaaS environment.

- Payments Experience: You have direct experience working with payment processors, gateways, or products with a transactional economic model (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, FreedomPay). You intimately understand transaction fees, chargebacks, and online GMV dynamics .

- Autonomous Owner: You have the direction and confidence to take ownership of highly ambiguous projects with minimal oversight. You are accountable, proactive, and known for getting things done when you say you will.

- Influential Collaborator: You are personable and excel at stakeholder management. You know how to bring cross-functional teams together, push back with a clear POV when necessary, and drive consensus across the finish line.

- Expert Project Manager:  Proven track record of managing initiatives of medium complexity that require a high level of accuracy and dependability. You can manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Solution-Oriented Influencer:  You come to meetings with a clear point of view and feel comfortable pushing back and asking hard questions. You are personable, capable of influencing others, and skilled at bringing people together to drive results.

- Data Analysis:  An analytical mindset with proven experience in data analysis and financial modeling. You can translate raw data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

- Financial Modeling Experience:  The ability to create financial models to evaluate potential opportunities.

- Exceptional Communicator:  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams without direct authority.

- Analytical Thinker:  You have strong data analysis skills and high spreadsheet comfort. Experience with Salesforce, Looker, and Gong is highly preferred.

- Customer Centric:  Deep sense of empathy for user challenges and pain points.

- You have a Bachelor’s Degree in a related field; Masters Degree preferred but not required.

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Washington, DC; Tempe, AZ; Mountainview, CA
jobs.description:
About the Team

Our New Verticals team launched in 2020 with the purpose of delighting our customers and empowering local communities outside of just restaurants. Since then, we’ve launched Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Retail, and DashMarts while also building merchant services, dasher tooling and consumer products. New Verticals is the growth engine of DoorDash’s business and we are continuing to build and scale new businesses everyday! Grocery is one of our highest priority, most complex verticals that is key to acquiring consumers to new verticals outside of just restaurants.

About the Role

We are hiring an Associate on our Grocery Merchant Strategy & Operations teams to drive growth in our enterprise grocery business. In this role, you will drive key initiatives supporting some of our largest merchants on the platform. This role will be highly dynamic, and a given day may include deep analysis of a customer journey, ideating and setting up a test for a new growth bet that you wish to productize, building a point of view on the financial viability of a new initiative or deal.

You will partner closely with product, engineering, finance, analytics and sales / business development to bring these initiatives to life! The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect you to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Strategize. From first principles, you’ll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.

- Operate . Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.

- Analyze . Build models using spreadsheets, SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments.   You’ll use AI every day to accelerate and deepen that analysis.

- Experiment. You’ll transform strategies into operational experiments, product features and net-new tooling that create measurable outcomes.

- Build with AI . You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.

- Lead, collaborate and Influence. You’ll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 1-3+ years of experience. You’ve succeeded in similar cultures that are highly analytical and cross-functional (whether in tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience).

- You are an owner. You're always looking for opportunities to better your work product and own the outcome – both the good and the bad

- You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.

- You’re analytical. You let data win arguments, and you’re comfortable pulling your own data in SQL and building models in spreadsheets.

- You solve problems from first principles. You have a talent for synthesizing complex problems, can translate high-level goals into actionable plans, and enjoy implementing a process

- You’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you’re just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team.

- You’re unafraid of ambiguity. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environment

- You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you’re already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.

You have a completed Bachelor’s Degree in a field that builds a mix of quantitative and general critical thinking skills.

Our New Verticals team launched in 2020 with the purpose of delighting our customers and empowering local communities outside of just restaurants. New Verticals is the growth engine of DoorDash’s business and we are continuing to build and scale new businesses everyday!

About the Role

We are hiring an Associate to work on one of our newest businesses on the New Verticals Strategy & Operations team to help launch and scale a pharmacy delivery service. You will work on identifying expansion plans, ways to improve consumer quality, operational excellence, and sustainable growth by identifying & executing against strategic opportunities. In this role, you might work on initiatives like:

- Identifying, validating, and launching high-impact “0-to-1” initiatives that unlock new growth opportunities across the convenience merchant base

- Developing initiatives that strengthen DoorDash’s position as the preferred destination for pharmacy delivery through improved selection, discoverability, and quality

- Leading operational improvement projects focused on increasing order accuracy, fulfillment speed, and overall customer satisfaction

- Streamlining in-store fulfillment processes to improve efficiency and create a seamless experience for Dashers and merchant partners

- Developing and executing on programs that improve inventory accuracy and ensure real-time platform availability reflects in-store stock levels

This roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

This is an individual contributor position and you will report into a Senior Manager on the team. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Strategize. From first principles, you’ll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.

- Operate . Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.

- Analyze . Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.

- Experiment. You’ll transform strategies into operational experiments, product features and net-new tooling that create measurable outcomes.

- Build with AI . You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.

- Lead, collaborate and Influence. You’ll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 1-3+ years of experience. You’ve succeeded in similar cultures that are highly analytical and cross-functional (whether in tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience).

- You are an owner. You're always looking for opportunities to better your work product and own the outcome – both the good and the bad

- You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.

- You’re analytical. You let data win arguments, and you’re comfortable pulling your own data in SQL and building models in excel.

- You solve problems from first principles. You have a talent for synthesizing complex problems, can translate high-level goals into actionable plans, and enjoy implementing a process

- You’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you’re just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team.

- You’re unafraid of ambiguity. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environment

- You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you’re already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.

jobs.title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY; Austin, TX; Chicago, IL; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash Digital Ordering is DoorDash’s leading SaaS business unit, offering a suite of products across online ordering, branded websites and mobile apps, loyalty solutions, and more that enable restaurants to reach customers and grow their revenue through their own first-party channels.

The business is one of the fastest-growing segments within DoorDash, and yet is only scratching the surface of a generational opportunity to better serve hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas to help them grow their business and improve working lives in one of the country’s biggest industry sectors.

Strategy & Operations sits at the center of that opportunity. The team partners with Product to set the strategy and vision for every offering in the suite, across our SMB and enterprise merchants. We decide what to build, where to invest, and how to bring it to market, and we learn by putting products in front of merchants and running the experiments that show us what moves their business.

As part of this team, the Associate will take end-to-end ownership of one or more product initiatives and lead the cross-functional execution that brings them to life. Your work will be instrumental to helping grow Digital Ordering into an industry-leading B2B SaaS offering.

About the Role

As an Associate on the Digital Ordering Strategy & Operations team, you will own one or more product initiatives within our first-party suite from end to end. You will develop the strategy, define key results, and drive execution in partnership with S&O, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, and Marketing. This role is ideal for a strategic operator who can move fast and wear many hats, equal parts analyst, builder, operator, and cross-functional leader.

You will own zero-to-one experiments and initiatives that improve products already operating at scale, help shape the roadmap with Product, and work directly with merchants and frontline teams to identify the gaps worth solving. Scope on this team grows with demonstrated ownership, and the people who do well here identify problems independently and come back with a plan to solve them.

You will join the Foundational Products team, the products that are table stakes for every restaurant we serve and that drive the core of our revenue today across SMB and Enterprise. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager of Strategy & Operations, Foundational Products.

We’re especially excited about candidates who’ve worked in fast-moving, founder-led, or resource-constrained environments, those who see lack of structure as an opportunity to build.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own product initiatives from end to end and be accountable for their results

- Imagine, develop, and execute on workstreams from start to completion with little oversight

- Oscillate easily from strategic considerations to tactical execution

- Build deep and meaningful relationships with merchants, laser focused on helping them thrive

- Have the opportunity to truly make a scalable, measurable impact on the restaurant industry in the US and abroad

- Operate comfortably in ambiguous environments while maintaining a strong bias for action

- Grow your scope as you demonstrate ownership and impact

- Communicate precisely dependent on audience and level of detail necessary to share

- Represent the DoorDash brand with humility and a customer-first mindset

Your responsibilities will include:

- Own product initiatives: Take end-to-end ownership of one or more product initiatives. Develop the strategy, define goals and key results, and build the business case, financial model, and go-to-market plan. Drive execution from launch into growth, with accountability for the results.

- Lead cross-functionally: Bring Product, Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, Sales, Marketing, and Support behind a plan and hold partners accountable to it without formal authority. You will be the connective tissue that keeps a launch on schedule and the feedback loop that informs what gets built next.

- Analyze: Pair complex data analysis with qualitative insight from merchants and frontline teams to guide strategic decisions. Build your own models, assess weekly performance against key results, and translate findings into action plans, adjusting course as needed.

- Experiment: Design and launch zero-to-one tests, build AI tools and automations to support internal processes and product launches, and pilot tools, demos, or prototype agents. Move quickly to retire what does not work and scale what does. You will work directly with merchants, including occasional travel to stores and running in-market tests as needed.

- Represent the merchant: Act as the voice of the merchant and the field, leading discovery interviews and synthesizing feedback from Sales, Implementation, Support, and merchants themselves to help influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities. You will ensure our products resonate with restaurants and scale with repeatable excellence.

- Scale learnings: Codify what works. Build the repeatable frameworks, processes, and enablement that raise the bar across the org, and define best practices for launching new products in a way that’s scalable and measurable.

The best candidates will:

- Think like a founder, identifying the problems nobody flagged, building the case for solving them, and driving them to resolution with limited structure or direction

- Bring strong analytical horsepower and intellectual curiosity, comfortable diving into complex data and extracting insights that drive real-world decisions

- Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments, moving with urgency, defaulting to action, taking ownership end to end, and knowing when to bend process to get things done

- Lead cross-functional teams through influence, building trust with Product, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing partners and holding them to their commitments

- Communicate clearly across audiences, presenting findings and defending recommendations with data

- Have experience working closely with Sales or frontline teams, and know how to turn insights from those teams into action

- Bring hands-on experience using AI, automation, or internal tooling to improve workflows or prototype solutions

We’re excited about you because you…

- Have 2-3 years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, product, or founder-type roles

- Have taken a product or initiative from inception through launch and into growth, leading cross-functional partners without a fully defined brief

- Demonstrate the judgment to identify gaps worth solving and shape product priorities alongside S&O and Product partners

- Can independently devise and execute a strategy to achieve business outcomes

- Bring a strong analytical background, with the ability to synthesize large data sets into meaningful insights (proficiency in SQL preferred)

- Lead cross-functionally and influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Marketing

- Define goals and key results for your initiatives, and hold yourself accountable for achieving them

- Bring exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain insights, defend recommendations, and tailor messaging across frontline teams, senior leaders, and merchants

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
About the Team

Design Program Managers make DoorDash's Design Studio run better. As owner of the Logistics pillar within Design Operations, you're accountable for one of our most important operating outcomes: maximizing the bandwidth of the team.

About the Role

You'll find where ICs and managers lose time, fragmented workflows, manual processes, meeting overload, unclear rhythms, and you'll define and build the tools and systems that fix it. That might mean shipping a new internal tool, automating a recurring workflow, redesigning how scheduling or reviews work, or establishing a better operating cadence. You own the full loop: diagnose the problem, design the system, build the tool, measure whether it worked.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own the Logistics outcome, maximize the bandwidth of the team. ICs and managers have more usable time. Meeting load decreases. The team can focus on high-value work.

- Identify the biggest sources of operational drag across the Studio and turn them into a prioritized roadmap of tools and process fixes.

- Define and build the tools, automations, and workflows that reduce manual coordination, including for scheduling, budgets, vendor management, and event logistics.

- Redesign how the Studio operates: reviews, planning cadences, rhythms for both ICs and managers, information flows,  whatever determines how fast teams can move.

- Measure whether your systems work, usable time for ICs and managers, meeting load, adoption, hours of manual work eliminated, and iterate.

- Turn recurring requests into scalable solutions. The second time a problem shows up, build the thing that stops a third.

- Own scheduling, budget, vendor, and logistics programs as a builder, not a permanent executor, your job is to make them need less manual effort every quarter.

- Partner with (and, as scope grows, help develop) other DPMs on the Logistics pod.

We're excited about you because you have…

- 5+ years in operations, program management, or business operations, building systems and tools that made a complex org run better. Design/product/creative org experience is a plus; EA or Chief of Staff backgrounds are welcome if you've built beyond pure execution.

- A builder mindset: you've created tools, workflows, or automations that replaced manual work — not just performed manual work well.

- Product-manager instincts applied to operations: find the real pain point, diagnose root cause, prototype, ship, measure, iterate.

- The ability to own an outcome independently at L4/L5 scope — you don't need the problem pre-scoped for you.

- Comfort with AI and no-code tooling (Claude, Cursor, Figma, or similar) to prototype and ship internal tools without needing an engineer.

- Strong written/verbal communication and the judgment to handle sensitive leadership and operational info with discretion.

What success looks like

Maximize the bandwidth of the team. ICs and managers have more usable time. Meeting load decreases. Team can focus on high-value work. Manual workflows become automated. Recurring problems become systems that scale. Your job is to create capacity — not just manage it.

The Dasher & Logistics team supports the millions of Dashers who power DoorDash’s marketplace. We’re building the world’s leading last-mile logistics platform — and to succeed, we’ll need to disrupt ourselves along the way. The Dasher Financial team is one such disruption: we are building fintech products that best serve the needs of Dashers and gig workers like them.

From instant access to earnings, to innovative bill pay and savings products, to credit-building tools, our goal is to create the financial system of record for Dashers. Today we serve 2M+ monthly active Dashers, and the business has more than doubled in the past year — and we’re still early, launching and scaling zero-to-one products that redefine how Dashers interact with their money.

About the Role

We are looking for a Manager, Strategy & Operations to join our Dasher Financial team. This role is about building new fintech bets from the ground up — from testing early hypotheses to scaling into category-defining businesses.

As a Manager, you will operate like a GM-in-training: shaping strategy, owning execution, and ultimately building the P&L for a new fintech product line. Early projects may include leading our efforts in lending and credit , but the role will flex to whatever the highest-potential opportunities are for Dasher Financial. This is a rare opportunity to be at the forefront of fintech innovation inside a scaled platform.

You will:

- Identify new product opportunities, size the market, and build the business case.

- Design and run experiments to validate user demand.

- Own day-to-day execution and work cross-functionally to take ideas from concept to launch.

- Define success metrics and be accountable for business outcomes.

- Scale promising products into sustainable businesses that improve Dashers’ financial health.

Dasher Financial is an ambitious bet — building fintech products for the future of work. As a Manager, you will have end-to-end ownership of a new product line, from incubation to scale. You’ll have the platform and data of DoorDash, but the freedom to build like a startup founder. For someone who aspires to be a GM or startup founder, this is a unique opportunity to learn by doing and build a business from zero to one.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Strategize: Develop the roadmap for new fintech bets and shape how DoorDash serves gig workers financially.

- Own: Take full ownership of a product line, from metrics to operations to user adoption.

- Influence: Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, and Marketing to turn vision into execution.

- Experiment & scale: Launch MVPs, measure user behavior, iterate quickly, and scale the ones that work.

- Grow as a GM: Build the skills to run a full business line — strategy, P&L, operations, and product — within one of DoorDash’s highest-potential growth areas.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 5+ years of experience in high-growth environments (tech, fintech, strategy & ops, consulting, or banking).

- You have a track record of taking ambiguous problems and turning them into scaled outcomes.

- You can take a vague, undefined problem and structure it yourself — without waiting for a framework — and use data to decide what to do (comfortable with SQL/Excel).

Our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team is re-inventing the way consumers think about grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail delivery through both our first-party and third-party operations businesses. Our third-party operations business [internally known as 3P], enables both shopping and last mile delivery for third-party enterprise & SMB merchants we partner directly with.

About the Role

We are looking to hire a Manager for New Vertical Logistics, to own workstreams that will directly impact bottom line efficiency and the end-to-end dasher experience. You will own dasher efficiency metrics, build the strategy and execute to drive impact and hit your goals, and improve the Dasher experience to keep our fleet healthy. You will work directly with a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, Product, Engineering, and Analytics.

You will report to a Senior Manager within our Central Strategy & Operations team and manage a team of one. We operate in a hybrid model - you will spend some time in your home office, in person via offsites and testing your new products or features in 3P stores.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Build & Analyze. You’ll do whatever it takes to launch and ship new features to drive dasher efficiencies and improve the dasher experience — from writing complex SQL queries to drafting product requirements and supporting new feature launches. You’ll assess the operational and financial impacts of experiments, model tradeoffs, and iterate based on data.

- Scale. You’ll transform analytical insights into experiments that create measurable and scalable improvements in dasher efficiency.

- Experiment. You will identify variance drivers, develop hypotheses, and test model and product changes in partnership with Product, Engineering, and Analytics — including leveraging AI-enabled tools to uplevel the way we operate internally & externally.

- Collaborate. You’ll influence a cross-functional team, including finance, engineering, product, and data science, driving alignment on roadmap priorities.

- Lead. You will manage at least one direct report.

- Own. You love owning problems end-to-end. You display ownership for the products and business lines that you are responsible for. You never shy away from raising your hand to solve ambiguous problems and are able to motivate and empower your teammates to go above and beyond.

We’re excited about you because…

- You’re analytical. You have a strong analytical background and advanced SQL proficiency. You live and breathe numbers and use them to understand problems and tell stories.

- You are AI native. You have working proficiency with Claude and Cursor and know how to use AI to increase your productivity without reducing the quality of your output.

- You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to solve operational problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.

- You’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds with data and real life operations, but you’re just as comfortable influencing roadmap discussions and strategic priorities.

About the Team

Our sales and partner management teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, enabling us to sign and partner with top restaurants across the country to drive revenue and help our partners operate and grow their businesses. As DoorDash grows both in scale and breadth of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it.

About the Role

As the Manager of Sales Strategy & Operations for Sales Tooling, you will be the core DRI for DoorDash’s third-party (3P) technology ecosystem. You will play a pivotal role in executing against top company business objectives by owning the 3P portfolio of our centralized Sales tooling operation. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Sales Tooling, you will manage spend tracking and license optimization across the 3P budget, ensuring that every tool in our stack directly contributes to sales productivity and operational efficiency.

Strategic Ownership & Governance:

- Oversee the end-to-end strategy and execution of DoorDash’s 3P sales tooling portfolio.

- Act as a thought partner on “build vs. buy” decisions as it relates to our 3P vs 1P stack of sales tools.

- Operate and continuously improve the tooling governance process (intake, scoring, SLAs, and routing to Legal, Security, and Procurement) to eliminate redundant "shadow" procurement across lines of business.

- Run structured tool evaluations, make scale or sunset recommendations to the governance council, and execute approved procurement and decommissioning.

Cross-Functional Partnership:

- Gather and synthesize requirements from Sales teams to shape tool selection and feature asks.

- Partner with GTM Technology & Product to ensure all 3P solutions align with technical requirements and architectural standards.

- Work closely with Revenue Operations to measure and report on the sales productivity impact of all tooling investments.

Vendor & Lifecycle Management:

- Act as the main point of contact for 3P sales tooling partners, holding vendors accountable to roadmaps that resolve existing challenges and implement enhancements.

- Serve as the central DRI for tooling licensing, access management, and permissioning to accelerate decision-making and reduce operational friction.

Execution & Enablement:

- Partner with Enablement to drive adoption and best practices for 3P tools across sales teams, and track adoption and sentiment.

- Develop a centralized repository for tooling documentation and best practices to resolve current information silos.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will be driving…

- Tooling Optimization: Drive the evaluate, renew, and retire decisions that move us toward fewer, better tools and a 1P-first stack where possible.

- Governance in Motion: Optimize and oversee tooling governance council cycles and decision calendar running, ensuring fiscal discipline and eliminating redundant "shadow" procurement.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with GTM Technology, Product, Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, and the Sales Analytics AI pod to align technical requirements with business goals and productivity outcomes.

- Tooling Optimization and ROI: Analyze usage data and performance metrics to derive actionable insights, identifying trends and providing recommendations to evolve or decommission tools to maximize ROI.

- Sales Productivity Strategy: Collaborate with Sales leads across all lines of business to identify friction points and implement 3P or AI-enabled solutions that accelerate the sales cycle and improve rep efficiency.

- Vendor Roadmap Influence: Be the key point of contact for your 3P vendors, providing structured feedback and holding them accountable to committed roadmaps and SLAs.

We’re excited about you because you have…

- A bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience in Sales Operations, GTM Technology, or Sales Strategy, ideally in a fast-paced tech or e-commerce environment.

- Experience managing SaaS tools and vendor relationships, with exposure to renewals and contracts in partnership with Procurement and Legal.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill technical tooling challenges into clear business cases for leadership and the tooling governance council.

- The ability to navigate large datasets to measure tooling adoption and business impact.

- Demonstrated experience in driving operational rigor and governance in a decentralized environment.

- An Architect at Heart – You think in systems, not just features; you treat every broken process as a build opportunity and every data gap as a use case waiting to be deployed.

- Entrepreneurial – You have a bias toward action, an ownership mentality, and the ability to thrive in a constantly changing environment.

- Gritty – You are willing to roll up your sleeves to map complex workflows, diagnose gaps, and do whatever it takes to make our tooling stack successful.

- A Relationship-Builder – You can influence and motivate stakeholders at all levels, from technical engineers to frontline sales managers.

- Operational & Rigorous – You independently translate high-level strategy into actionable project plans with strict attention to detail and efficiency.

Qualifications

- Experience: 6+ years in Sales Operations, GTM systems and tooling, or Sales Strategy, ideally supporting a sales tech stack; tech or marketplace experience preferred.

- Strategic Execution: Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional initiatives, hitting goals, and succeeding in a complex, fast-moving environment.

- Analytical Prowess: Excellent analytical thinker who can deliver actionable recommendations from complex usage and productivity datasets; Salesforce and Excel experience required, SQL preferred.

- AI-Native Builder: Proven explorer of AI tooling to drive efficiency; experience mapping complex operational workflows and architecting AI-enabled solutions. You are comfortable using tools like Claude or ChatGPT to prototype automation that eliminates manual work and accelerates decision-making.

- Communication: Expert communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple vendors and internal stakeholders simultaneously.

- Systems Thinking: Experience with the end-to-end lifecycle of sales tools—from process discovery and technical requirement gathering through to prototype, deployment, and global enablement.

Nice to Haves

- Experience with the "Modern Sales Stack"

- Experience in procurement or managing large-scale SaaS budgets.

- Background in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) or project management certifications.

If you are a seasoned leader with a passion for optimizing technology to drive business results and want to be part of a dynamic, growing organization, we encourage you to apply for the Manager, Sales Strategy & Operations (Sales Tooling) position at DoorDash.
