jobs.title: Manager, Strategy & Operations, DoorDash for Business
jobs.location: New York, NY
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash for Business provides meals solutions to companies, but we aren’t stopping there. Our mission is to become a premier benefits partner for executives, employees and administrators across the globe, leveraging the DoorDash platform to deliver industry-leading selection, quality, and customer service to every business customer, for every business use case. We are building an entrepreneurial, customer-obsessed, and fast moving team to create the right products and services for the future of work.

About the Role

As a  Manager, Strategy & Operations (Audience Growth & Product Strategy) , you will play a critical role in shaping how DoorDash for Business grows its customer base, expands platform adoption, and identifies new product opportunities that can accelerate the business.

You will own the strategy for growing our audience of companies, including how we identify, prioritize, acquire, activate, and expand across key customer segments, personas, industries, and use cases. You will also own product growth strategy for our core platform, helping define how we increase adoption, engagement, retention, and customer value across existing products.

In addition, you will help identify and evaluate net-new product opportunities that can unlock future growth. This includes sizing opportunities, understanding customer pain points, validating demand, shaping early GTM strategy, and partnering with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, and Finance to determine where DoorDash for Business should invest.

A core part of this role will be owning the voice of the customer . You will create structured feedback loops that capture insights from executives, administrators, employees, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and market research, then translate those insights into clear recommendations that inform product roadmaps and business priorities.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of growth strategy, product strategy, analytics, customer insight, and cross-functional execution.

Reporting to the Head of Growth Strategy and Operations, DoorDash for Business, you will work closely with operators, field teams, product and other teams to make your vision a reality.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Strategize
Develop audience growth and product growth strategies for DoorDash for Business, identifying the highest-impact customer segments, personas, use cases, and product opportunities to grow the business.

- Operate
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, Finance, Operations, and Engineering to turn growth priorities into clear plans, experiments, launches, and measurable outcomes.

- Build
Create scalable growth playbooks, dashboards, research processes, and operating cadences that help the team better understand customer needs, product adoption, and expansion opportunities.

- Grow
Drive growth for the core platform by identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, feature adoption, and overall customer value.

- Explore
Evaluate net-new product opportunities by sizing markets, understanding customer pain points, validating demand, assessing GTM feasibility, and recommending where the business should invest.

- Champion the Customer
Own voice-of-customer feedback loops across customer interviews, Sales and Customer Success insights, surveys, support trends, and product usage data to inform product roadmaps and business priorities.

- Analyze
Use SQL, AI tools, customer research, and product analytics to uncover insights, prioritize opportunities, and translate data into clear recommendations for cross-functional partners and senior leaders.

- Construct

About the Team

Our team is the strategic operating arm for DoorDash's Enterprise Partnerships organization. This role supports our Global Restaurants Partnerships business — the largest enterprise sales and account management org at DoorDash, spanning the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a small, senior team measured on two outcomes: the productivity we give back to our sales and account teams, and the incremental revenue opportunities we generate with our largest partners across the business.

About the Role

As Manager, Strategy & Operations for Enterprise Partnerships, you'll be a strategic partner to the leadership of DoorDash's Global Restaurants business. This is a builder's role: you'll find where the org is losing time or leaving revenue on the table, then design and ship the AI-powered tools, programs, and cadences that fix it. Expect to spend most of your time leading one or two strategic projects end to end, with the rest split between further automating the team’s operating cadence and absorbing the high-priority asks that come with supporting a fast-moving global org. You'll have a rare birds-eye view of DoorDash's largest enterprise org, direct exec exposure, and room to grow the scope you own. This is an individual contributor role. We expect it to be hybrid, with roughly three days per week in the NYC office.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Drive sales productivity: Find where our sales and account teams are losing hours to manual work, then build the AI-powered tools that give that time back.

- Unlock merchant engagement: Design and run the programs that generate incremental revenue with our largest partners.

- Build with AI: Stand up the systems that make us the best-informed player in the industry — infrastructure the team relies on every week, not one-off analysis.

- Make the case with data: Build the cases for new initiatives — including opportunity sizing, resources required, and impact to the team — and bring these directly to leadership.

- Operate globally: Partner with restaurant leadership across the US, Canada, and Australia to align strategy, and coordinate proactively with our Wolt and Deliveroo counterparts.

- Own the operating cadence: Overhaul and automate the cadences that keep a global org aligned, making them sharper and more decision-oriented.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 7+ years of experience in strategy, operations, management consulting, or as a general manager, ideally at a fast-paced tech company.

The business line you’ll be supporting is fast-growing, fast-paced, and is obsessed with efficiency. We are looking for someone to manage daily site regional operations via our 3P relationships.

About the Role

The Regional Operations Manager, Drive (Parcel) will own the day-to-day operations in a specific region within the U.S. They will work with both internal and external stakeholders to manage site operations. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Parcel. We expect this role to be up to 40% travel.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Commerce Platform Enterprise Online Ordering - Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY; Denver, CO; Los Angeles, CA; Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash is building a new category of B2B SaaS products that help restaurants manage and grow their businesses - one of the company's most strategic and high-visibility initiatives, backed directly by senior leadership. The business is one of the fastest-growing segments within DoorDash, and yet is only scratching the surface of a generational opportunity to better serve hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas and improve working lives in one of the country's biggest industry sectors.

You will operate with the speed and autonomy of an early-stage startup, but with the resources, data, and scale of a public company. The team is small, the problems are complex, and your work will directly shape how we go to market, what we build, and how thousands of merchants grow their businesses.

About the Role

You’ll build, refine, and own the infrastructure and operating models that support the growth of DoorDash’s Enterprise Digital Ordering business, helping enterprise restaurant merchants transform their first-party digital experiences. As part of a key pillar within DoorDash’s Commerce Platform, you’ll work on high-impact initiatives with visibility across senior leadership, including the executive team.

Within the Launch / Solutions Architect pod, you’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Integrations, Design, Merchant Operations, Analytics, Marketing, and Finance, while working directly with enterprise merchants. You’ll help build and scale a platform that brings together DoorDash products and restaurant integrations to help merchants reach and retain customers, preserve their distinct brand identity, and grow sales.

What You'll Work On

- As a member of the DoorDash Commerce Platform Strategy & Operations (S&O) team, you will play a critical role in driving growth across our various products and services. You will be a founding member of the Product Operations function and help us build a world class ProdOps team while delivering 1st party online ordering products to market for our Enterprise restaurant partners.

- Your initial focus will be to build, refine, and own the infrastructure required to support massive growth in our nascent Enterprise Digital Ordering business. You’ll do this by partnering cross-functionally, winning prioritization of key projects (largely through influence), and creating systems that allow for seamless execution and constant improvement at scale.

- As the team and product mature, your scope will expand to additional projects that help the Platform team build and drive adoption for digital ordering products in the Enterprise segment.

- Join to help us:

- Establish, improve, and own processes required to launch Merchants onto our suite of digital products

- Help Mx customize and optimize their first-party digital ordering experience

- Build and lead a high performing Product Operations team

- You will be aligned to specific products or partnerships, and you will own all work streams related to building and executing strategies to drive growth, increase adoption, make operations more efficient, and collaborate cross-functionally to bring solutions to life.

Our products sit within the DoorDash Commerce Platform that serves enterprise restaurant brands, regional chains, and independent operators. You'll be working across multiple products at varying stages of maturity.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will …

- Build and own the business – Drive growth and adoption of some of our top priority projects

- Business development – Develop and foster deep relationships with top priority merchant partners to iterate and grow the business.  Key Merchant point of contact within the Strategic Initiatives Strategy & Ops team

- Go-to-market strategy – Build a strong understanding of product market fit, value proposition, pricing, and the competitive landscape, and help the team develop a go-to-market strategy based on these inputs. Grow a high-potential offering within a high-growth business.

- Improve the product –  Guide operational improvements for our merchant partners by understanding their needs and working with internal partners to design solutions throughout the product experience. Steer the Drive product roadmap informed by quantitative analysis and qualitative merchant feedback

- Influence – Work cross-functionally with our Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Support, Sales and Account Management teams to drive growth and scale.

- Experiment –  Evaluate and test various revenue, cost and quality drivers.

We’re Excited About You Because…

- You have a Bachelor’s degree or higher

- You have 3+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, or operations; high-growth/early-stage startup or entrepreneurial experience is a big plus

- Your expert communication and interpersonal skills set you apart

- You are a strong analytical thinker who can provide applicable recommendations out of a complex, sometimes murky, dataset

- You have a bias towards action and are able to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly changing work environment

- You crave responsibility and want to shape the vision and direction of the company

- You’re willing to get your hands dirty and you’re open to feedback.

What You'll Actually Do

This is as much a strategy role as it is an operations role. Below are examples of the types of problems you'll be tasked with owning or supporting upon joining the team:

- Run competitive positioning. Map the landscape, build the case for why merchants should buy this over alternatives (or over doing nothing, which can sometimes be the more common competitor).

- Sell directly to merchants. This is a consultative sales motion. You'll be on calls with merchant decision-makers — marketers, operations leads, franchise business consultants — deeply understanding their workflows and goals to help them understand how these tools can solve their day to day problems and provide them with additional leverage.

- Onboard merchants. Design and run the onboarding experience. Figure out what drives high adoption and stickiness across different org structures.

- Shape the product. You're the closest person to the merchant. You'll feed quantitative data and qualitative feedback into the product roadmap. When operators tell you something, you'll ask 20 more questions to more deeply understand where they're coming from — and whether the product, the pitch, or both need to change.

- Work cross-functionally. Our closest team members are Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Sales — the right person for this role can get technical where needed (hello Claude Code!) and collaborate heavily with account owners to sell direct to Merchants. If you've ever thought - "I wish a job existed where I could build new products alongside Product/Eng, and engage directly with end customers" then you're in luck.

This Role Is for You If...

- You've brought a product to market before — or been close enough to the process that you know what it actually takes (not just the framework, the work)

- You're genuinely curious about the product. You'd ask for a demo before you started strategizing about go-to-market. You'd want to understand the problems a merchant is trying to solve before building a pitch deck.

- You can sell. Not "support the sales team" sell — actually get on a call with decision makers, understand their problems and objections and influence them.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. These products are at different stages. Priorities shift. You'll need to manage context-switch between building a prototype, standing up a new merchant facing process and troubleshooting a merchant issue in the same afternoon.

- You use AI tools to give yourself leverage. You build workflows in Claude Code, automate analysis, and use AI to move faster than someone without those tools. This is how you operate day-to-day, not something you're "interested in exploring."

- You have a strong personality and build rapport easily. You can work with opinionated, direct stakeholders and hold your own without being combative.

- You'd rather go talk to an end customer than sit in a room theorizing about what they want.

This Role Is NOT for You If...

- You need structure handed to you. There's no established playbook, no onboarding curriculum for the products, no "here's how we've always done it."

- You're more comfortable analyzing than doing. This role requires you to build things, sell things, and make decisions with incomplete information — not write recommendation decks.

- Your AI fluency means using ChatGPT to wordsmith emails and polish slide decks. We mean something different: using tools like Claude Code to build workflows, automate repetitive analysis, and give yourself operational leverage. If that distinction doesn't resonate, this isn't the right fit.

- You operate better on an island. The cross-functional partners here are smart and opinionated. You need to build trust and navigate that these relationships both internally and externally.

- You want a clearly scoped lane. This is a Swiss-army-knife role across multiple products at different stages. If you want to go deep on one thing, this will frustrate you.

What We're Looking For

We care more about what you've done and how you think than anything else.

Backgrounds that tend to map well:

- Restaurant or food tech operators who've been close to the merchant experience

- SaaS go-to-market roles, especially at early-stage or growth-stage companies

- Startup operators who've worn multiple hats and built processes from scratch

- Consultants - but the kind who built things, not just advised on them

- Product Managers - you have deep digital product experience & strong instincts: you’ve studied and built world class consumer experiences (ideally in ecommerce).

What matters:

- You've done some version of consultative selling — whether that was your title or not

- You have real product curiosity (you dig into how things work, not just how to position them)

- You're fluent with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, similar) as part of your daily workflow

- You can write clearly, present persuasively, and hold a room with senior stakeholders

- You offer program/project management expertise: you can masterfully scope and manage a months-long, complex/technical project from end to end (and likely even have preferred processes and tools to do so).

- You’re a strong communicator: you can interface with senior audiences, internally and externally; you can easily articulate complex details and help audiences quickly understand the “so what”

- You have an extreme sense of ownership: you take full responsibility for your scope of work. You are proactive in solving ambiguous problems and inspire your teammates to excel.

- You’re detail-oriented: you have meticulous attention to detail, ensuring no small element is overlooked. Your thoroughness helps you anticipate issues and plan beyond immediate tasks.

- You’re even-keeled: you thrive under pressure and maintain a sense of calm when facing challenging and time-sensitive goals.

- You’re a builder: you thrive on building from the ground up. You excel at creating structure and process, and you’re resourceful in figuring out answers to complex questions with minimal oversight.

- You’re low ego: you want to GSD and are willing to do whatever it takes to make that happen; no responsibility or task is too trivial or “too tactical.”

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis
Compensation

About the Team

Our sales and partner management teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, helping us partner with top merchants (think restaurants, grocers, convenience stores, retailers) across the country to grow their revenue and help them operate even better. As DoorDash grows both in scale and scope of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it. The Pre-Sales S&O team focuses on the acquisition of SMB restaurants across the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

About the Role

As a Senior Associate on Sales Strategy & Operations, you'll take end-to-end ownership of the Canada SMB Inbound, Self-Serve Merchant Onboarding (SSMO), and Sales Development Representative (SDR) functions — the core engine behind restaurant acquisition for Canada. You will own the strategy, goaling, and forecasting infrastructure for these channels, manage relationships with stakeholders across sales, marketing, and vendor partners, and be accountable for day-to-day performance and ongoing improvement of the business. You'll be expected to operate with significant autonomy — identifying opportunities, shaping strategy, and leading initiatives that produce measurable outcomes — and you'll also help the team use AI and automation to scale its own productivity, building tools and workflows that create leverage well beyond your own workload. You will report into the Canada Pre-Sales RevOps Lead on our Pre-Sales S&O team in our Sales Strategy & Operations organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own – Take full ownership of the Inbound, SSMO, and SDR functions for Canada, including goaling, forecasting, and pacing infrastructure

- Build – Design and encourage adoption of new sales products, processes, and tools (including AI-powered workflows) that scale team productivity

- Strategize – Partner with Sales leadership to build effective, cost-efficient go-to-market strategies and structural changes to the sales motion

- Analyze – Build and maintain models (walk-to-goal, forecasting, ROI) that evaluate performance and surface opportunities for improvement

- Influence – Work across Merchant S&O, Sales, Analytics, Planning, and other Sales S&O teams to scale business impact, and represent Canada's needs in broader regional/global conversations

We're excited about you because…

- You have a Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience in management consulting, tech, investment banking, corporate strategy, or business operations; high-growth or early-stage startup experience strongly preferred

- You have a track record of owning a function or workstream end-to-end — diagnosing problems, designing the fix, and carrying it through to measurable impact — and you can build models and frameworks (forecasting, ROI, walk-to-goal) from ambiguous inputs to inform decisions

- You have excellent Excel skills, are proficient in SQL and Snowflake, and are comfortable building your own tools and automations (e.g., with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted tools) to create leverage; this isn't a coding role, but a bias toward building over manual workarounds is important for success here

- You are entrepreneurial and self-directed, requiring minimal oversight, and you're a strong cross-functional partner who has built alignment across teams with competing priorities

The Senior Associate, Marketplace Audience Strategy & Operations role is for truth seekers who enjoy getting scrappy while also examining data, creatively problem-solving on a daily basis, driving insights on business performance trends, using AI to drive efficiency, and working across a cross-functional organization to bring strategies to life. About the Team

Our US Marketplace team is responsible for growing the DoorDash business in the US, helping customers to discover & order what’s best in their city, merchants to grow their sales, and dashers to find flexible work.

About the Role

The US Marketplace team is looking for a motivated and hands-on Associate Manager to join the Strategy & Operations Growth and Markets team. You will own a portfolio of projects aimed at growing the core Marketplace business, working closely with DoorDash’s product, marketing, finance, and analytics teams.You’ll have the opportunity to help grow strategic markets, identify new growth bets, incubate 0-1 experiments, and execute on a roadmap to drive growth.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Build and own. You’ll have your fingerprints all over DoorDash’s next wave of growth. You’ll do whatever it takes to launch, get 1% better every day, and scale something completely new, from high-level strategy down to the nitty-gritty operational details.

- Incubate. You’ll take bets that don’t have an owner yet, scope them, test them, and either graduate them into funded programs or kill them with a clear, well-argued recommendation.

- Strategize. From first principles, you’ll develop the optimal strategy for growing segments and launching bets that no existing playbook covers.

- Experiment. You’ll turn strategies into operational experiments that create measurable, actionable outcomes, then use those results to shape the larger implementation plan.

- Analyze. You’ll pull your own data, assess the operational and financial impact of your decisions, and iterate based on what you find.

- Lead and collaborate. You’ll work with cross-functional partners across product, analytics, marketing, sales, and finance to get your initiatives resourced and shipped.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 4+ years of experience in a problem-solving role: consulting, tech, banking, or similar. Experience taking something from 0 to 1 is strongly preferred.

- You’re highly analytical. You’re a data-driven problem solver who is comfortable running your own analysis in Excel or Google Sheets; SQL experience is strongly preferred.

- You’re comfortable in white space. You like being handed an undefined problem with no template, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.

- You’re collaborative. You have experience partnering cross-functionally to drive results, and you can influence and motivate people you don’t manage.

- You’re able to think at the lowest level of detail while seeing the big picture. You get into the weeds, but you’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and thinking long-term.

jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Chicago, IL; Sunnyvale, CA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Atlanta, GA; Miami, FL; Boston, MA; Phoenix, AZ; Washington, D.C.
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash’s Commerce Platform empowers merchants with the tools they need to grow and operate their businesses. Drive On-Demand is a key component of this platform, providing white-label fulfillment solutions for retailers across multiple SLAs.

The Commerce Platform Logistics team is a sustainable growth team within Commerce Platform. We own Final Mile cost and efficiency, ensuring that DoorDash Commerce Platform is the most cost effective, reliable way for merchants to reach as many customers as possible through their first-party channels. This means expanding product offerings and improving network efficiency to simultaneously reduce fulfillment costs and unblock growth for merchants while providing Dashers with valuable earnings opportunities.

About the Role

At DoorDash, our goal is to empower local economies. A key part of that mandate is to improve fulfillment efficiency and costs to allow more merchants to scale e-commerce channels. We are looking for a leader with an “and not either/or” mindset who is passionate about driving sustainable growth. As a Senior Associate, Strategy & Operations – Delivery Cost, you will play a key role in analyzing, tracking, and improving fulfillment cost and efficiency, partnering with cross-functional teams to identify trends, scope impactful initiatives, and support the execution of network efficiency improvement strategies.

Your work will be both strategic and deeply operational. One day, you might be sizing the impact of a change to how we batch orders. The next day, you could be deep diving an escalation from a merchant or dasher and leading an experiment to drive real-world improvements.

As the part of this team, you will:

- Partner with Finance & Strategy to track and analyze fulfillment cost metrics across different lines of business and strategic merchants.

jobs.description:
About the Team

Our ambition for DashMart Fulfillment Services (DFS) is to power the best grocery experience, letting customers shop their full list 24/7 from their favorite merchant, with error-free same-day delivery at in-store prices. Carrying the right items across an extensive merchant selection is foundational to our infrastructure and consumer offering. This team owns both of those inputs end to end ensuring that we choose the right items, they arrive in the right quantities and on time and are fully in sync with our warehouse operations to make them available to consumers.

About the Role

We're looking to bring on a few Senior Managers with strong operational and analytical backgrounds that can tackle our most critical and ambiguous problems and build durable solutions at scale that will empower the long-term success of DFS. These roles require a holistic understanding of how we think through merchant selection & partnerships to how we build our fulfillment model. These aren’t insights roles - you will be expected to own root cause diagnostics, how to test operationally, and how to scale initiatives through productized solutions in partnership with product, engineering and local operations. One role will focus on merchant selection and one roles will focus on inventory health - both are critical to the end to end success of a DFS partnership.

A few of the problems you might own:

- Merchant Selection. Identify where to play and how to win from knowing what merchants our customers want, to where we should launch those as a test and determine what success looks like to scale.

- In-Stock. Own availability across forecasting, replenishment, receiving and labor planning. Find the binding constraint and decide what service level is worth paying for, by category.

- Catalog. The catalog is the promise we make before the order. Every error shows up later as a missing item, a wrong order or lost margin.

- Shrink. Shrink is the cost of the in-stock promise. Separate what ops can fix this month from what needs a systemic fix, and set the availability-versus-waste tradeoff deliberately.

These are people management roles, leading teams between 3-5 and reporting into our DashMart leadership. Throughout the interview process, we will consider you for both roles and align your strengths to the needs of each role.

You are excited about this opportunity because you:

- Take problems with no clear owner or structure, break them down to the root causes, and size the opportunities so we know what to go after first and what to sequence later

- Turn the diagnosis into a plan that has DRIs, initiatives, dates, and goals against each root cause, and drive it to completion

- Run the short-term and the long-term in parallel, scrappy fixes this month while designing what scales

- Partner with Product and Engineering on the problem statement, requirements, and prioritization, and stay accountable through launch and adoption

- Build the metrics, dashboards, and root cause analysis views so anyone outside the team can see how a KR is progressing and why, and keep a weekly pulse so trend breaks get caught early

- Work XFN with Supply Chain, Ops, Category Management, Vendor Management, Analytics, Product & Engineering and Finance to get everyone laddering up to the same goals, and be the escalation point when they don't line up

- Hire, develop, and manage 3-5 direct reports, set a high analytical bar, and make sure each of them knows what good looks like at their level

We're excited about you because

- You have roughly 8-12+ years in data science, analytics, strategy and operations, consulting, retail or supply chain, including time managing people and leading large cross-functional workstreams.

- You've built teams and grown analysts from individuals who can diagnose a problem into solution owners.

- You're strong in SQL and comfortable using the latest AI tools for analysis (Claude, Cursor), you can build models and design experiments, and you can go to the lowest level of detail yourself when it matters

- You've taken ambiguous operational problems from diagnosis to a scaled, productized solution in partnership with product & engineering.

- You can navigate comfortably between strategy and detail, and between product, engineering and site operations.

Nice to haves.

- Grocery, convenience, or e-commerce fulfillment background including supply chain, inventory and category management

- Hands-on experience with forecasting or ML systems

- Experimentation experience

About the Team

At DoorDash, we're redefining the future of on-demand delivery. At the center of this is our marketplace, connecting 30+ million customers on DoorDash with their favorite restaurants and brands! The Marketplace team focuses on growing our consumer business, including DashPass, our global subscription program. Our vision is to create the world’s leading membership program in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world class experience to members.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager, DashPass Strategy & Operations to build and own the merchant co-funding strategy behind DashPass. DashPass benefits are what make membership the most valuable proposition in local commerce — this role is about making them sustainable and scalable by unlocking merchant investment in them.

You'll sit at the intersection of our consumer subscription business and our merchant and monetization teams. You'll define what merchants get from DashPass, quantify it credibly, and turn that into co-funded offers that scale across the full spectrum of merchant cohorts — from our largest Enterprise brands down to hundreds of thousands of SMBs, each with fundamentally different economics, decision-making, and tooling needs. You'll also be the voice ensuring the benefits we put in front of members are evaluated on merchant outcomes, not just consumer ones. Success in this role depends on building conviction with data and driving outcomes across product, engineering, data science, marketing, finance, and commercial teams without direct authority.

- Own the DashPass co-funding strategy end to end — define which benefits merchants should fund, at what level, and why; build the business case that makes it compelling for merchants and accretive for DashPass

- Build and defend the merchant value proposition for DashPass — quantify incremental volume, new customer acquisition, and order frequency attributable to DashPass, and turn that into a repeatable, credible pitch our commercial teams can carry

- Influence the promotions and monetization product roadmap — represent DashPass co-funding requirements for offer types, targeting, eligibility, and measurement, and bring a stack-ranked, evidence-backed set of asks

- Be the DashPass DRI in merchant commercial conversations — size the impact of DashPass components in long-term agreements and partnerships, set the guardrails, and protect long-term member and merchant economics

- Hold the member benefit roadmap accountable to merchant outcomes — establish the framework, metrics, and review cadence that ensure new benefits drive positive results for merchants alongside members, and bring a defensible point of view when the two are in tension

- Model complex tradeoffs and bring a strong POV to senior leadership — frame ambiguous, cross-functional decisions with data and carry them to executives

- Experiment and scale — turn strategy into operational experiments with measurable outcomes, then build the processes and tools to scale what works

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own. Be the DRI for how DoorDash funds the most valuable membership program in local commerce, with end-to-end ownership of a strategy that’s still being written

- Build. Create the merchant value proposition for DashPass from first principles — the analysis, the narrative, and the offerings our commercial teams take to market

- Drive “visible from space” impact. Unlocking merchant funding at scale creates a new, durable source of investment in member benefits — materially changing the economics of DashPass and the business

- Model. Frame ambiguous, cross-functional tradeoffs with data and carry a strong, defensible point of view to senior leadership

- Shape. Influence the promotions and monetization product roadmap by translating merchant and member needs into clear, prioritized requirements

- Influence. Drive alignment and outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and our commercial teams without direct authority

- Experiment. Transform strategy into operational experiments that create measurable, actionable outcomes — then scale what works

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 8+ years of experience in strategy & operations, commercial strategy, management consulting, investment banking, business development, product operations, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning ambiguous, high-stakes problems end-to-end

- You’ve built the business case for a two-sided value exchange — where a decision has to work for two different sets of stakeholders with competing economics — and can hold a credible point of view on both sides

- You’re comfortable in or adjacent to commercial conversations (MSAs, up-front agreements, pricing, partnerships) and can hold your ground against counterparts with competing incentives

- You have strong quantitative and structured problem-solving skills, can self-serve data (intermediate+ SQL/Excel), and can defend your conclusions to skeptical executives

- You have a bias to action. You move quickly and thrive in a fast-paced environment. No job is beneath you and you lead from the front

- You possess a “breakthrough walls” mentality. You are constantly pushing the envelope of what is possible and can figure out a way to make almost anything happen

- You have clarity of thought — you can articulate a clear vision to cross-functional partners and are unafraid of ambiguity

- You communicate complex ideas clearly across technical, commercial, and executive audiences

- Subscription, marketplace, advertising, retail-media, or merchant/SMB experience is preferred

- A bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Ops - Sales Compliance
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Atlanta, GA; Chicago, IL; Denver, CO; Washington, DC; Austin, TX; Phoenix, AZ; Los Angeles, CA; Seattle, WA; Boston, MA
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Sales Compliance team makes sure DoorDash and Deliveroo charge every merchant correctly and sell in a way that is compliant and built to scale. We own sales controls, revenue assurance, and order-to-cash (OTC) controls across the Merchant organization, from the signed contract, to how it is configured in our systems, to the charge a merchant sees. We are part of Sales Strategy & Operations, which builds the go-to-market strategies, processes, and systems that help our sales teams move faster and grow revenue across every business line.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead Sales Compliance for our new and emerging businesses, and to run it like a strategy and operations business, not a checklist. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and team behind DoorDash’s sales controls: key SOX revenue controls, contract-to-system-to-charge reconciliations, and the systems, data, and processes that make compliant selling the default. Your mandate is to protect revenue and audit outcomes while making it easier, not harder, for Sales to grow.

This role focuses on DoorDash’s new and emerging business lines, where products, pricing models, and contract structures are still evolving and many controls are being built for the first time. You will set the compliance foundation for these businesses as they launch and scale.

You will lead a distributed team of compliance managers and analysts, and partner with Sales leadership, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Accounting, Legal, and Internal and External Audit. You will report to the Director, Sales Compliance.

[Work model — hybrid]

YOU’RE EXCITED ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY BECAUSE YOU WILL…

- Lead. Manage and grow a team of Managers, Associate Managers, and analysts across the US, Canada, and Mexico. Set the bar for analytical rigor, audit-ready work, and judgment, and develop the next layer of leaders.

- Own. Be the DRI for sales controls and revenue assurance across new and emerging business lines, held to the standard of 100% of merchants charged correctly, 100% of the time. Own the effectiveness of key SOX revenue controls for these businesses and represent them to Accounting and Internal and External Audit.

- Strategize. Build the multi-year roadmap for compliant selling. Prioritize by revenue exposure and risk, and bring new products, pricing models, and markets into scope as they launch.

- Build. Move the program from manual review to automated, scalable controls: a trusted contract source of truth, automated reconciliations, anomaly detection, reliable data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows, in partnership with Product, Engineering, and Analytics.

- Influence. Partner with business line leaders and Product at launch so controls are in place from day one. Design compliance into how Sales works, including pricing and commission changes, contract design, merchant onboarding, systems access, incentives, and training. Reinforce good selling behavior so controls speed teams up instead of slowing them down.

- Analyze. Quantify revenue leakage and exposure, root-cause systemic issues, and turn findings into business cases with clear owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

- Communicate. Bring control outcomes, risks, and recommendations to Sales, Finance, and Audit leadership, and hold a firm, data-backed position when growth and control are in tension.

WE’RE EXCITED ABOUT YOU BECAUSE…

Required

- You have 8+ years of experience in strategy & operations, sales or revenue operations, internal or external audit, SOX compliance, risk, or management consulting.

- You have 3+ years of direct people management experience, and a track record of hiring and developing strong teams.

- You have owned a control environment or a revenue-critical process (pricing, billing, commissions, contracts, or order-to-cash), whether you designed it, ran it, or audited it.

- You can work with data yourself and direct analytics work: advanced Excel or Google Sheets, and enough SQL fluency to review and challenge your team’s analysis.

- You have led cross-functional programs with Product, Engineering, Finance, or Legal and delivered measurable results without direct authority.

- You communicate clearly with executives and auditors, and you can defend your conclusions to a skeptical audience.

- You are AI-forward. You use AI tools and automation to scale your team’s output, not just your own.

- You bring structure to ambiguity and balance rigor with speed.

- Big 4, internal audit, or SOX program leadership experience

- Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and order-to-cash processes

- Hands-on SQL, or experience managing analytics or data engineering talent

- Experience with Salesforce, contract tools (e.g., DocuSign, PactSafe/Ironclad), billing systems, or systems access controls

- Experience launching or scaling new products or business lines, or building controls in a 0-to-1 environment

- Experience at a marketplace, high-growth technology, or multi-country business

The goal is to accelerate product stickiness and unlock growth at scale.

Client Success is a great place to build both hard and soft skills, including consultative product expertise, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional collaboration, as the link between what customers need and what we build.

About the Role

Scaled Client Success Managers own product adoption, education, and onboarding for a pooled segment of our longtail unmanaged customers in North America. You'll be a proactive, solutions-oriented partner who delivers enablement and activation at scale through digital-first programs and remaining client facing while you introduce new products and features and help customers get more out of the ones they already use.

We are a diverse, global team working to help our customers meet their business goals through creative problem-solving, data and deep product knowledge, always with a customer centric approach. Our team is a group of empathetic relationship builders, curious minds, doers, thinkers, strategizers, and friendly humans who are passionate about supporting the hospitality industry.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to drive the long-term success of our customers by supporting them across the full lifecycle, including activation, adoption, and growth. This role blends scaled execution with higher-touch relationship management, ensuring customers receive a more personalized experience while still operating efficiently across a broader portfolio. DoorDash is seeking a Director of Sales Enablement, Training & Go-to-Market to lead the design, delivery, and execution of programs that accelerate the productivity, effectiveness, and growth of our global Sales organization. As part of this mandate, you will also lead the deployment of AI tools, including Claude, across the Sales organization. AI is becoming core to modern selling, and you will own the strategy for embedding it into seller workflows while serving as the Sales voice in cross-functional GTM forums shaping how AI is rolled out to adjacent customer-facing teams (Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing, and Support).

- Own the Onboarding Experience: Design and continuously improve new-hire onboarding for SDRs, AEs, and AMs across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, with clear milestones, certifications, and ramp targets that demonstrably shorten time-to-productivity.

- Build Continuous Learning Programs: Run a year-round curriculum of skills training, product education, segment-specific bootcamps, and sales kickoff content that keeps reps sharp and aligned with strategy.

- Embed a Sales Methodology: Select, customize, and operationalize a sales methodology (Challenger, MEDDIC, SPIN, or similar) across the org, with reinforcement built into pipeline reviews, deal inspection, and manager coaching.

- Tailor Enablement Across Business Models: Deliver differentiated playbooks and training for SaaS, Ads, and Marketplace solutions, equipping reps to position value, handle objections, run effective discovery, and cross-sell seamlessly.

- Own Sales Content Strategy: Build and govern a content system (pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, battle cards, ROI tools, email templates) that is easy to find, easy to use, and continuously refreshed based on rep and customer feedback.

- Lead Product Adoption & Expertise: Partner with Product, Ads, and Marketing to launch new features and offerings into the field with clear positioning, training, certification, and measurement of seller readiness.

- Coach & Develop Sales Talent: Build a coaching culture by enabling frontline managers with frameworks, call review rituals, deal coaching playbooks, and tools to consistently raise the performance bar.

- Run the Enablement Operating Rhythm: Establish the cadence (intake, prioritization, launch calendar, feedback loops, post-mortems) that makes enablement predictable and trusted by Sales leadership.

AI & Sales Productivity

- Lead AI Deployment for Sales: Own the strategy, rollout, and adoption of Claude and other AI tools across the Sales org. Build prompt libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and certification paths that turn every seller and manager into an AI power user.

- Elevate Sales Productivity with AI-First Workflows: Drive adoption of AI-powered workflows for prospecting, account research, call prep, proposal generation, deal coaching, and post-call follow-up. Replace manual work with intelligent automation wherever it creates leverage.

- Drive Measurable AI ROI: Define and track the business impact of AI in Sales, including hours saved, pipeline generated, win-rate lift, content velocity, and quality improvements, and continuously expand the use cases that move the needle.

- Influence GTM-Wide AI Direction: Represent Sales in cross-functional GTM AI working groups, share what’s working with CS, Marketing, Partnerships, and Support leaders, and help shape enterprise-wide standards for tooling and prompts, without owning execution outside Sales.

- Support Responsible AI Use: Partner with Legal, Security, and IT to apply DoorDash’s AI usage guidelines, data handling policies, and quality controls within Sales, and feed Sales learnings back into enterprise policy.

Leadership & Impact

- Own Business Impact Metrics: Define and track KPIs including ramp time, quota attainment, seller productivity, content utilization, certification rates, and incremental revenue growth attributable to enablement programs.

- Strengthen XFN Partnerships: Act as the connective tissue between Sales and cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Ops, Marketing, IT, Legal), ensuring alignment on GTM priorities, seamless rollouts of new initiatives, and continuous feedback loops to Product and Ops.

- Lead and Inspire: Manage and develop a high-performing global team of enablement managers, trainers, instructional designers, coaches, and GTM program leads.

We’re Excited About You Because:

- 12+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Training, or Sales Leadership in high-growth SaaS, Ads, or Marketplace companies, with at least 5+ years leading enablement teams.

- Proven track record of designing onboarding and continuous-learning programs that measurably reduced ramp time and increased quota attainment at scale.

- Deep knowledge of modern sales methodologies (Challenger, MEDDIC, SPIN) and demonstrated experience embedding them across a multi-segment sales org.

- Strong content strategy chops, including governance, taxonomy, sales content tooling, and measurement of content effectiveness.

- Skilled at designing and leading manager coaching frameworks, call review programs, and deal inspection rituals that improve win rates and deal velocity.

- Experience tailoring enablement to multiple business models (e.g., SaaS subscriptions, Ads, Marketplace) and multiple segments (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise).

- Applied AI deployment experience: You have personally rolled out LLM-based tools (Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot, or similar) to a sales org and can speak credibly to prompt design, workflow integration, change management, adoption metrics, and measurable outcomes.

- AI fluency in practice, not just theory: Comfortable with prompt engineering, evaluating model outputs, designing human-in-the-loop workflows, and integrating AI with CRM, enablement, and conversation intelligence platforms.

- Experienced in building cross-functional partnerships with Product, Marketing, and Operations, and comfortable representing Sales in broader GTM forums.

- Strategic GTM thinker able to translate complex product roadmaps into clear, actionable sales motions.

- Exceptional leadership and team-building skills with a global mindset.

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and executive presence, with a data-driven approach.

- Familiarity with enablement platforms (Highspot, Seismic, Mindtickle), conversation intelligence (Gong, Chorus), LMS tools, CRM systems (Salesforce preferred), and enterprise AI platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google).

DoorDash’s ability to build the best products in the industry, enabling local commerce at global scale, depends on its ability to recruit, engage, grow, and retain the best talent in the industry. The People Applications team at DoorDash is responsible for building and scaling first-party (1P) products that support the entire employee lifecycle from recruitment through to offboarding. The team develops and operates People Applications used across all DoorDash brands, including Wolt and Deliveroo.

About the Role

The DoorDash People Applications team is seeking an Engineering Manager with experience building and scaling applications across talent acquisition, compensation, and employee experience domains.

In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the future of our People platform as we accelerate the adoption of AI and evolve our 1P products to drive greater efficiency, innovation, and employee experience.

This is a highly collaborative role where you will help shape both the technical direction and product strategy, ensuring our solutions align with DoorDash’s people team’s goals while delivering reliable, high-impact experiences for employees across all brands.

This will be a hybrid role and you will report to the Senior Manager, Enterprise App Engineering.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Lead and Inspire: Manage, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of full stack engineers across multiple DoorDash locations including in US and Hungary

- Drive Technical Vision: Partner with the team to define architectural roadmap for the team.

- Deliver Impactful Features: Oversee development of core People Application product experiences, including data pipelines, automation and integration with AI tools/LLMs.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Work closely with product managers, UI/UX designer, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into impactful, user-first solutions.

- Operational Excellence: Establish best practices in development processes, testing, release management, and monitoring.

- Embrace AI: Passion for leveraging AI and automation to improve developer velocity and business outcomes

We're excited about you because you have…

- BS, or MS in Computer Science or related field

- 2+ years of experience in people management leading full-stack teams of 5+ engineers

- 7+ years of industry experience in software development, ideally in HR-related applications

- Extensive experience as an engineer in a fast-paced, product-focused development environment

- Experience with distributed system design, system scaling, and performance optimization including leveraging AI to improve velocity

- Experience with Generative AI development and fine-tuning such as setting up prompt flows, agents, guardrails, and knowledge base optimization.

- Hands-on leadership, strong business acumen and strong product intuition

About the Team

The Customer Experience team serves as a foundational operations pillar at DoorDash, dedicated to resolving friction within the last mile. We architect and oversee an expansive global network of support centers — spanning both teammate-assisted and AI-driven support — obsessing over the user journey to ensure every interaction is seamless and reliable. As the analytics team, our mission is to make every support interaction measurably better: we define what a great resolution looks like, quantify where we fall short, and turn that into a roadmap for product, operations, and AI/ML partners. We are looking for a Manager to lead and grow the analytics team behind our core support experience.

About the Role

As a Manager on the Customer Experience Analytics team, you'll set the analytical vision for how DoorDash measures and improves customer resolutions across our global network of support teammates and their interactions with our customers. You'll lead and grow a team of data scientists working at the intersection of customer experience quality and operational cost — uncovering opportunities to drive perfect interactions and informing improvements to teammate tooling that leverages AI-driven resolutions. You'll establish a clear measurement framework for resolution quality, own insights to drive strategy and roadmap, and align partners across CX, Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI/ML. This is a high-visibility leadership role: success means better outcomes for customers, a more effective support organization, and a team of data scientists who are growing in their craft.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Lead, grow, and develop a team of data scientists — providing mentorship, feedback, and clear career development pathways.

- Set the analytical vision for the core support experience, defining what a great customer resolution looks like and building the metrics to measure it.

- Uncover opportunities to drive perfect interactions, translating patterns in contact and resolution data into a prioritized roadmap for product and operations partners.

- Inform improvements to teammate tooling and workflows, and quantify the tradeoff between customer experience quality and operations cost.

- Partner with AI/ML teams to design evaluation frameworks that measure and improve support quality.

- Drive measurement strategy for the area under scope, setting best practices around experiment design, statistical analysis, and success metrics.

- Interface frequently with senior leadership across CX, Product, Engineering, and Operations to showcase your team's work and shape strategy with data.

- You have experience managing and developing data scientists or analysts and know how to set a high bar on quality, ownership, and impact.

About the Team

Product Partnerships sits within the Enterprise Sales organization and is responsible for the strategic vision, acquisition, management, and growth of DoorDash’s partnerships with all the merchant, restaurant technology, and advertiser technology providers. Given the scale and complexity of our key partners, this team is a critical component of DoorDash’s growth and success in every market we operate in.

You’ll leverage AI-powered insights, data-driven signals, and emerging tools to shape strategy, inform decision-making, identify opportunities, and drive growth across complex, enterprise-level engagements. By integrating AI and data-enabled analysis into day-to-day workflows, you’ll improve prioritization, execution, and business impact while partnering cross-functionally to translate evolving platform and AI capabilities into clear, tangible value for partners and the business.
About the Role

We are looking for a Manager, Ecosystem Partnerships & Initiatives, to shape how we identify, structure, and scale our most important partner relationships across our Digital Commerce Platform. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, go-to-market, deals, product, and business operations, and will be a key thought partner to the Enterprise and GM leadership teams.

You will own the operating system for the partnerships org: defining partner categories and partnership strategy; building frameworks for when to partner, build, or buy; driving cross-functional alignment (Product, Sales, Finance, Legal, Ops); and ensuring our deals are structured for long-term value and operational success. You will also own and drive the rhythm of the business, bringing structure and rigor to the lean, high-impact product partnerships team.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role suited for someone who is equally comfortable building models in Excel/Sheets, creating exec-ready narratives, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with partner managers to land and scale complex deals.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you…

- Excel at developing and executing a multi-year strategy and roadmap for our partner ecosystem across our Digital Commerce Platform (e.g., online ordering, loyalty, data and reporting, guest engagement, and other emerging products)

- Thrive in Business Development / Partner Management roles, working through ecosystem design, sourcing, deal strategy, negotiation, contracting, and ongoing management

- Are energized by turning a set of standalone products into a connected ecosystem, where partner integrations, distribution channels, and go-to-market motions reinforce each other instead of competing for the same restaurant

- Care about how a product actually shows up for an independent restaurant and its guests, not just how the partnership reads on paper

- Seek out opportunities to bring structure - be it in developing deal templates and guardrails (e.g., revenue share bands, MDF/marketing commitments, data-sharing rules, exclusivity / tiering structures) or driving internal deal review committees with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Legal, Finance, Sales, Ops) to ensure alignment prior to signing

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 8+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, management consulting, platform strategy, S&O, or similar roles. Restaurant tech experience is even more valuable

- You can take an ambiguous partner landscape, impose structure, and turn it into a clear portfolio strategy and execution plan.

- You have a track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing partnership agreements, and structuring commercial terms (revenue share, licensing, MDF, exclusivity) that hold up as the relationship scales

- You can operate across a multi-product portfolio and know where partnerships create real leverage versus where they add complexity without payoff

- You're comfortable being the connective tissue between Product, S&O, Legal, and Finance, driving alignment without needing authority to do it

- You use data to make the case for where to invest — building pipeline views, ROI models, and partner scorecards that inform prioritization

- You hold a bachelor’s degree; an MBA or other advanced degree is preferred.

We expect this position to be filled by 9/21/26.

- Experience leveraging data, AI-informed insights, and emerging AI tools to drive strategic decisions, enhance productivity, and improve outcomes in complex business environments.

- Strong ability to interpret AI-generated insights, synthesize them into clear, actionable recommendations and executive-level narratives, and influence stakeholders.

- Baseline fluency in AI concepts, with a willingness to continuously learn and adopt new technologies as AI capabilities become increasingly embedded in workflows, products, and customer interactions.

jobs.description:
About the Team

The DoorDash Global Sourcing team operates across three brands: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, and more than 40 markets, as part of the broader Global Procurement, Sourcing, Travel and Supply Chain organization. Its mandate is to build a world class global sourcing capability that captures enterprise synergies through aligned category strategies and delivers measurable value creation beyond savings, including business enablement, risk reduction, and stronger commercial outcomes.

Global Sourcing is organized around three category towers: Technology, Corporate Services, and Marketing. The team focuses on increasing category maturity through disciplined strategy, governance, and supplier management, while harnessing suppliers as a source of innovation, resilience, and competitive advantage. The team is in the middle of a multiyear transformation of its operating model, tooling, and ways of working.

About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Global Strategic Sourcing, this role is a strategic and operational partner and a force multiplier across strategy, execution, and communication. You will steward the long term category wave plan, run transformation program management and the operating rhythm, carry the sourcing narrative, lead high visibility special projects, and help keep the team healthy and engaged. The role amplifies the team and enables the Category Leads. This is a role for a sharp, low ego operator who can move fluidly between shaping thinking and getting the details right, and who leads through influence rather than authority.

What You Will Do

Steward the long term category wave planning

- Assemble and maintain the multiyear category wave plan, sequencing sourcing initiatives across the Technology, Corporate Services, and Marketing towers, and across the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt brands, translating agreed category strategies into one coordinated plan.

- Partner with Category Leads to keep the plan realistic, resourced, and current as business priorities shift across more than 40 markets, while the Category Leads retain ownership of their category strategies.

- Track progress against the plan, surface risks, dependencies, and resourcing conflicts early, and frame the tradeoff decisions needed to keep waves on track.

- Connect the wave plan to value creation targets beyond savings, including business enablement, risk reduction, and category maturity.

Carry the Sourcing narrative and communications

- Craft and steward the narrative for the Global Sourcing team, turning strategy and results into clear, compelling stories for leadership, stakeholders, and the wider team.

- Draft executive communications, leadership updates, business review materials, and all hands content for review and approval.

- Ensure consistent messaging across brands and stakeholder groups, tailoring communications for individual contributors, executives, and, where relevant, external partners.

- Own communications for transformation initiatives, making sure changes are explained clearly and land well with the teams they affect.

Drive transformation program management

- Run program management for the sourcing transformation, including milestone planning, dependency and risk management, and benefits tracking across all workstreams.

- Coordinate delivery with the Procurement Center of Excellence, the category towers, and cross functional partners in Finance, Legal, Engineering, and Operations.

- Assess the impact of proposed changes on people, processes, systems, and stakeholders, and recommend the revisions needed to plans, processes, and ways of working.

- Keep the transformation roadmap and supporting documentation current as scope and priorities evolve, and drive decisions and follow through to closure.

Liaise internally and externally

- Act as a point of coordination between the Global Sourcing organization and cross functional partners across all three brands.

- Support relationships and communication with relevant external partners

Lead special projects

- Own ambiguous, high priority projects that do not fit neatly into any one category tower or brand, scoping the problem, building the plan, and driving to outcomes.

- Assemble and lead working groups across functions, holding contributors accountable to milestones without direct reporting authority.

- Prepare leadership and business review materials and recommendations grounded in data.

Support team health and engagement

- Keep the team connected and support team health across a distributed, multi brand team through rituals, offsites, recognition, and shared moments.

- Guide new joiners as they settle in and get up to speed.

Run the operating rhythm

- Design and run the operating cadence of the Sourcing leadership team, including staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles, and goal tracking.

- Set agendas, capture decisions and action items, and follow through to closure.

What We Are Looking For

- 6+ years of experience, with a background in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, management consulting, or a related field.

- Strong project and program management skills, with a track record of driving complex, cross functional initiatives from ambiguity to measurable outcomes.

- Excellent listening skills and the ability to synthesize input from many stakeholders into a clear point of view.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication, able to tailor a message for an individual contributor, an executive, or an external partner.

- High EQ and strong relationship building skills, comfortable influencing and leading through others without formal authority.

- Analytical and structured, fluent in working with data to frame decisions and tell a story.

- Highly organized and detail oriented, able to juggle multiple priorities across brands and markets in a fast moving environment.

- Discretion and sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive information.

Nice to Have

- Experience supporting a senior leader in a PMO, business operations, or comparable role.

- Exposure to procurement or sourcing transformation, category management, or supplier negotiations.

- Experience operating across multiple brands, regions, or markets in a high growth technology, marketplace, or logistics company.

jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Sunnyvale, CA; Seattle, WA; Chicago, IL; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Atlanta, GA; Miami, FL; Boston, MA; Tempe, AZ, Washington, D.C.

About the Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about, helping grow businesses and the communities that support them. To further this mission, we’re looking for an experienced paid media operator to join our Consumer Marketing team at a pivotal time for DoorDash Ads and paid co-marketing.

The Cx Ads Paid team plans, launches and measures paid media campaigns with brand and CPG partners, working alongside Ads Integrated Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and our agency partners. The team is growing, and this person will help shape how paid marketing operates as it scales.

About the Role

We’re looking for a strategic, decisive paid marketing leader to own Co-Marketing Paid Media strategy and operations in the US as it pertains to supporting Co-Marketing Merchant priorities. This role will support +20 strategic campaigns across $XXM covering CPG, Restaurant, and New Vertical industries. You will set the operating model, make the decisions that keep the campaign on track against launch timing, ROAS performance, and advertisers commitments. You will be the voice of Paid in cross-functional forums, arriving with data, a clear point of view and a recommendation, and you will lead agency and platform partners as the single accountable owner. This is your opportunity to influence and own a Paid marketing function as a lead, touching channel decision making and strategy with Director + visibility.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own the end to end paid marketing operations, from intake and planning through launch, in-flight management and recap

- Make independent decisions on campaign operations and bring a clear recommendation to cross-functional discussion: For example channel mix, creative, and optimization strategies.

- Problem Solving: When there are unknowns, be the central driver to align on things like budgets, partnership commitments, and required approvals

- Lead agencies and platform partners such as our Media Agency, Meta and The Trade Desk, from brief to delivery

- Drive strategic projects end to end, including building channel playbooks, process revamps and the test-and-learn agenda

- Lead and develop a team of 2 (with opportunity to scale), delegating ownership of processes and planning capacity against the campaign calendar

- Must have experience interacting with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) and the ability to learn new tools quickly.

- Leadership Communication Opportunity: Keep leadership and partners informed with proactive updates, early risk flags and escalations that come with a proposed solution

- Deliver recap reports and performance readouts with a clear narrative and benchmarks, ready for Marketing and Sales review

We’re excited about you because…

You’re a decisive, results-oriented marketer who has led paid media programs and XFN teams. You form a point of view from data, act on it, and keep the right people informed along the way. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, delegating work you should not be doing yourself, and holding partners to a high bar. You have experience managing leadership and can write and speak concisely to such an audience

- 5-8 years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, campaign management or marketing operations

- Experience managing agencies and paid channels such as CTV/OLV, programmatic, paid social, and DOOH

- Strong command of campaign measurement, including ROAS, benchmarking and root cause analysis of performance

- Track record of owning cross-functional projects and decisions without direct authority

- Sound judgment on when to decide, when to align and when to escalate

- Excellent written and verbal communication, with examples of leadership-ready updates and recommendations

- Experience building and scaling processes, trackers and playbooks

- [Preferred] Experience in CPG, QSR or marketplace co-marketing, and with tools such as Sigma, iSpot or Monday.com

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash

- We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.

- We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.

- We are learning - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.

- We are customer obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.

- We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

- We offer great compensation packages and comprehensive health benefits.

About the Team

The SMB Business Development team is responsible for managing key partnership moments with our most strategic restaurant partners. Our team steps in at pivotal times—such as contract renewals, exclusivity negotiations, and high-impact strategic initiatives—to ensure long-term success before transitioning accounts back to the broader Account Management team. We collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Strategic Finance, Selection, US Local Markets, and Legal to drive retention, exclusivity, and deal efficiency at critical junctures.

About the Role

As Manager, SMB Business Development - Retention , you will lead our efforts to drive success in key partnership moments, ensuring that our most valuable restaurant partners maximize their potential on our platform. You will own strategic interventions that drive retention and exclusivity, execute high-stakes deal strategies, and enhance product adoption during pivotal phases of the restaurant partnership lifecycle. Additionally, you will lead a team of four direct reports, focusing on their growth and effectiveness in executing high-impact partnership engagements. This role requires a strategic mindset, strong negotiation skills, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will report to Blair Toll , Sr. Manager of Business Development, within the Rx Success organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Own Key Partnership Moments – Drive successful engagement at critical phases such as renewals, exclusivity negotiations, and strategic initiatives before transitioning accounts back to Account Management.

- Lead a High-Performing Team – Manage and develop four direct reports, fostering career growth and performance excellence.

- Drive Strategic Initiatives – Lead the Business Development marketplace retention strategy, including proactive renewals, upsells, churn mitigation, deal structuring, and performance optimization at crucial points in the relationship.

- Execute Competitive Strategies – Develop and implement competitive strategies in response to evolving market dynamics and competitor moves.

- Work Cross-Functionally – Partner closely with Account Management, Account Development, Strategic Finance, Selection, US Local Markets, and Legal teams to optimize retention and enhance partner value during key moments.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have extensive experience in strategic account management – 6+ years of experience in restaurant partnerships, business development, or enterprise account management.

- You are a strong negotiator – You have a proven track record of structuring and closing high-value deals at pivotal moments.

- You are a people leader – You have experience managing and developing a team of high performers.

- You are data-driven – You leverage data and analytics to inform decision-making and strategy.

- You excel in cross-functional collaboration – You have experience working across multiple teams to drive business outcomes.
